notes.title: Nordic Ashes coming to Nintendo Switch and PS5
notes.notes: [p]Hello vikings![/p][p] [/p][p]Since the start of the year, we’ve been working on console porting and today we wanted to share a HUGE announcement![/p][p][b]We joined forces with Selecta Play and Nordic Ashes physical editions for Nintendo Switch and PS5 will be available at the end of this year![/b] [/p][p]Preorders are available already. You will find some of the links at the end of this post.[/p][p][/p][h2]What will you find in this edition?[/h2][p]We’ve named it [b]Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga[/b] and it will include:[/p][list][*][p]Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok (Base game)[/p][/*][*][p]Nordic Ashes: Remnants of Corruption (Tower DLC)[/p][/*][*][p]Nordic Ashes: Dark Knights (Skin DLC)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/41e57bf09d520e9be568a57f6a474692ae7e8122.png"][/img][/p][p]As we are old school, we wanted to add a physical [b]Game Manual to both Standard and Collector’s editions[/b], as we believe it’s something rare to find nowadays and it brings that classic game vibe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/e9651d3468bd6966ef86ac3c9b2023028a98ac83.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve seen that the content description of these editions may vary depending on the store. However, this is the official list of things the game will include, regardless of where you buy it:[/p][h3]Standard edition:[/h3][list][*][p]Game + 2 DLCs [/p][/*][*][p]Game Manual[/p][/*][/list][h3]Collector’s Edition:[/h3][list][*][p]Game + 2 DLCs [/p][/*][*][p]Game Manual  [/p][/*][*][p]Artbook[/p][/*][*][p]BSO[/p][/*][*][p]9 stickers (Dark Knights + Gnöki)  [/p][/*][*][p]Gnöki Keychain[/p][/*][/list][h2]Release date [/h2][p]We don't have an offical date yet, even if you see it in a store, as that will depend on our providers, but we are confident that it will be around December 2025.[/p][p][/p][h2]Preorders[/h2][p]Preorders are already available so you can secure your copy. notes.title: Update v2.0.5 DLC - Balancing and fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello Vikings![/p][p] [/p][p]These past weeks we’ve been updating Remnants of Corruption DLC to try and make it more fun and balanced, which has always been our goal. Some of the most important improvements have been:[/p][list][*][p]Regarding Normal, Hard, and Expert levels have been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced wave time/room duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Hardcore will remain challenging, we don't want to loose that Ragnarok essence.[/p][/*][*][p]The rarity of weapon stat upgrades now depends on their level. This means that at level 1 they will grant common upgrades, at level 3 they will grant rare upgrades, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]As you climb the tower floors, the weapons you collect will appear at a higher level.[/p][/*][*][p]Meta-progress corruption has been significantly reduced. Upgrades that improve stats no longer increase corruption.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DLC Update[/h2][p]Today’s update will cover new improvements and fixes that will keep balancing Remnants of Corruption DLC.[/p][list][*][p]New constellation display for this game mode.[/p][/*][*][p]New floor tiles for higher floors and final boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Hardcore and Endless have been enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty increased on floors +50 in Endless Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]You may switch to Endless mode after finishing a Hardcore run.[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorials have been added.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/266939dcdb5f022905d5bbf93a86fbb525d44721.png"][/img][/p][h2]Summer in Vanaheim[/h2][p]To celebrate [b]Steam’s Summer Fest,[/b] just as last year[b],[/b] we decided to brighten up Vanaheim and turn it into a beach party!  From today [b]until July 15th[/b] you’ll be able to play [b]Summer in Vanaheim[/b]. This will not change playability, as it will be summer cosmetic skin.  [/p][p][/p][h2]Summer themed relics[/h2][p]You can also enjoy [b]seasonal relics[/b]!  [b]Please notice that themed relics will appear more often than regular ones. On that note, you may disable the Summer event on the Settings panel if you prefer to play regular runs.[/b]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/0258adb30ed4f3d0c7adc698df50c8b30d346354.png"][/img] [/p][h2]Unn’s Fire skin [/h2][p]Unn’s Summer Fest skin: the [b]Fire skin[/b]. This is the time of the year when it will be much easier to get Unn's skin. Win one run in Vanaheim while this event lasts to unlock her forever. notes.title: v 2.0.2 Balancing & fixes
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

Today we're releasing another update that brings several changes and fixes. We're constantly reading your comments, reviews, and suggestions, and we know there's still work to do before everyone can fully enjoy the DLC. We won’t stop until we get there!

[b]Changes and Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage will no longer increase as you progress through the tower (it was being increased every 10 floors). It is now exclusively linked to corruption. Corruption Level 1 will increase damage by half a heart, and from Level 2 onward, it will increase by a full heart per corruption level.
[*] Other buffs granted to enemies by corruption have been adjusted.
[*] Enemies will no longer spawn near the player character.
[*] When a boss dies while casting attacks, those attacks will stop immeadiately.
[*] The Purification Room will now remove more corruption every 10 floors.
[*] Adjustments have been made to XP generation and enemy behavior in Endless +50. Let us know how it feels!
[*] Fixed a visual bug affecting the display of Masteries XP and Deities XP at the end of a run.
[*] Bosses are now “heavier” and less prone to being pushed, especially while casting attacks in specific positions.
[*] Alruna's skeletons should now stay within the rooms.
[*] Minor text and bug fixes.
[/list]

This wraps up today's update, but we have more planned over the next few days!

As always, thank you all for your feedback! 
Cheers!

notes.title: v 2.0.1 Balancing & fixes
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

These past two days have been really intense!! Thanks for all your feedback and support. ːNA_Crystalː

We were aware that the Tower difficulty was advanced due to having played so many Ragnarok runs. But we want the overall experience to be positive, so we've made the following changes:
[list]
[*] Regarding Normal, Hard, and Expert levels: Reduced health and enemy spawns
[*] Reduced wave time/room duration.
[*] Hardcore will remain challenging, we don't want to loose that Ragnarok essence.
[/list]
As part of this DLC, if runs feel long, you can always save your progress and continue later.

Our main idea was to make this game mode feel fresh and new, and therefore, we've changed the Yggdrasil meta to the Tower one. However, it's true that you've missed upgrades such as damage, cooldown, etc. We've added new nodes with these stat upgrades.

Other fixes and improvements
[list]
[*] New enemy: Corrupt Squirrel 2. This one balances the other Corrupt Squirrel (the explosive one), so visibility improves and you can move around without dying so easily. More of the new Corrupt Squirrels 2 will appear and there will be fewer of the explosive ones.
[*] Ragnar’s and Astrid’s shields are now saved correctly. They no longer reload when the timer stops.
[*] Garth went into die animation when reviving.
[*] You won't face the same boss twice.
[*] Upgrade panels are better displayed.
[*] Hexed Emblen reilc was not unlocking.
[*] Corrupt shard reward wasn't showing properly
[*] Typo mistakes.
[*] Sound improvements.
[/list]

We will keep improving the game so it feels alive, that's for sure!

Thank you all for your feedback! With these changes, the game will be much more balanced.
Cheers!

notes.title: New DLC + Main game content
notes.notes:
Hello Vikings!!

We are extremely excited to share with you all the content we’ve been developing during the last 6-8 months. We will talk about this [b]NEW DLC[/b] (yay!) [b]FREE CONTENT[/b] (more yay!) and [b]NINTENDO SWITCH & PS5 digital AND physical editions[/b] (including collector’s edition, yay yay yaaaaay!!!). ːNA_Crystalː

(tldr at the end of the post)


[h2]Remnants of Corruption DLC[/h2]
Welcome to Remnants of Corruption and the Skada Tower. So, without further ado, let’s dive deep into this major update:

[i]This journey will take place inside a dark corrupt tower. Once you step inside, your only way out will be surviving the countless challenges the tower conceals.[/i]

Here you will face new enemies and bosses, including trolls, zombies and many more, including those tiny devious rats from Midgard we all loved and hated but in their corrupt form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/6a034ebe3e4556d691147241a67d5197f880d91f.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636780/Nordic_Ashes_Remnants_of_Corruption/

This DLC comes with the following features:

[h3]Corruption mechanic[/h3]
Every time you clear a room, corruption will rise. Whenever you are greedy and want juicer rewards, corruption will rise. The motto of this tower is that corruption rises whatever you do. And when corruption rises, the tower also morphs: enemies will become stronger, elites will learn new abilities, you’ll lose hearts easier and doom will absorb you.
Well, not really, but kind of.
Rewards at the start of each room
Every time you enter a room the tower will grant you new upgrades, so you can build yourself up and be a worthy opponent.

[h3]Doors – choose your path[/h3]
Each time you survive a room, you will be able to choose between two (or more?) doors. These doors will grant you a specific reward (hearts, gold, weapons…) once you complete the upcoming room. That way you will be able to choose your path as you wish.

[h3]New enemies[/h3]
You will face more than 40 new enemies and bosses. Find corrupt rats, squirrels, but also zombies, trolls and many more.
You’ll see most of them have a basic form and their corrupt one, with new abilities to try and match your power (please don’t let them beat you).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/2aa6b82af550d606dc76a88cb1296195014cdd75.png[/img]

[h3]New character! Lili[/h3]
A tower of corruption? So why not a cute happy girl who loves to hex everyone left and right! But who said cute and happy? Lili will devour all the darkness around her and morph into more terrifying and lethal forms!!
She will introduce Dark Hearts and hex-related relics such as her adorable Laser Plushie or minion Tentacles that will make her life much easier clearing the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/5cb2060cc13f7fef300fae663fc73db200d17a90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/62095456cef331da910f9de4f86740d57254fa3f.png[/img]

[h3]Deities[/h3]
To join you in this battle, you will be gifted by a deity of your choice to improve your runs substantially. Let’s say you choose Sol, the fire deity. This means, the probability of fire relics will drastically increase, so synergies will be more available.
Your deity will also perform a variety of attacks that will get stronger and stronger as you level up both during the run and outside, as you raise your affinity level with them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/96584bd345c5864c52e7eb4683b25d4d0201ace4.png[/img]

[h3]New relics[/h3]
New relics have been added to Remnants of Corruption. Many of them related to the corruption theme that will include a new status effect, hexing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ca6ed4bbff9ae6f8907e4a30a55a7177081bb93a.png[/img]

[h3]Skada Tower Metaprogress[/h3]
Many more levels to complete and make yourself unstoppable. 
Grab Corrupt Shards during your run and exchange them for powerful upgrades.

[h3]Original Soundtrack[/h3]
We are also really happy to join forces with Rubén Melià, who once again created amazing music for this new adventure! Many kudos for him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/b7db695d060bf2dfbb473319dd96c69d63099cdf.gif[/img]

[h2]Free extra content for Nordic Ashes[/h2]
We appreciate so much your love and support and it makes our day when we see you enjoying this game so much, reading your comments, watching videos…
We also wanted to add a good amount of extra content for FREE, to enjoy in the 9 realms in addition to the DLC!
So here we go:

[h3]New character! Garth[/h3]
Meet our protector guy, the shield man… our favorite paladin… Garth!!
Garth will introduce a new kind of heart, the Holy Heart and this will be his only way of surviving, as he won’t be able to grab other kinds of heart. But don’t worry, as he is a cool paladin and has his own healing secrets.
Regarding his weapons, you’ll be able to wield his Holy Hammer, Master Shield and many more relics.
There are more features related to Garth, but we don’t want that many spoilers :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c6cebb267e7498968a039f6b4571cc639226fd27.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/72dd1ef70084bd15b497748a36b0dcf72a60e19d.png[/img]

[h3]New relics[/h3]
We also wanted to create new relics for the main version of the game, so 30+ relics have been added. These include many fire, ice, thunder and poison relics in addition to relics related to fear, bleeding, gold, crit, and dash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/feed8fb6dc71cbdebac7f691b547a4111946c3a6.png[/img]

[h3]Artifact rework[/h3]
Most artifacts have been reworked. For example, the tarot cards now deal elemental damage in addition to the status effect they previously dealt. The gold ring will not only grab all the gold around you, but it will also grant extra gold for you to spend.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
We also made a few QoL and improvements such as:
[list]
[*] Language selection improved.
[*] Skin selection improved.
[*] Relic drops are smarter, being now relics that synergize with your character or the relics you already have.
[*] Chest drops are smarter too. They now only grant you passive stats that synergize with your relics.
[*] Hearts are now sorted in the order you collect them, but red ones will always be displayed first, followed by the rest.
[*] Improved the way enemy damage is displayed (it's now in the pause menu).
[*] Improved UI for Elite and Boss abilities to make them easier to identify.
[*] Game performance has been significantly improved.
[/list]

[h2]Nintendo Switch and PS5[/h2]
Nintendo Switch and PS5 editions are almost here!! When we started developing Nordic Ashes we would have never believed it would become a NS or PS title with its physical edition too!!
This title will be released for Nintendo Switch 1. We may make an adaptation to NS2 but for now, we will stick to the classic edition. As for Play Station, it will be for PS5.

[h3]Digital Edition[/h3]
This edition will include the main game, Remnants of Corruption DLC and the Dark Knights skin pack.
Digital NS Edition will be available on the NS Store in a few weeks! PS5 will possibly be available at the end of summer.

[h3]Physical Editions[/h3]
We will be releasing both the single and collector’s edition of the game hand in hand with [b]Selecta Play[/b]!
The single edition will be the exact same as the digital one, including the main game, Remnants of Corruption DLC and the Dark Knights skin pack.
Collector’s edition will include all the above plus really cool goodies, everything encased in a beautiful box. 

[h3]Pre-orders[/h3]
Pre-orders will be available  on limited quantities for the Collector’s edition.
Official release date hasn’t been fixed yet but it will be around the end of 2025.
Details about pre-orders in a couple of months!!


We hope you enjoy this new adventure, we poured our hearts and souls into this development. Thanks for your amazing support always! ːNA_Gnokiː

Cheers!
[b]Axeldör, Fengos and Naya, Nordic Ashes devs :D[/b]

Today we have a new DLC devlog! We wanted to post it yesterday but then we realized it was April fools lol.

We were planning to update with the Halloween event in a couple weeks but then we thought… why wait?
So let us introduce the [b]Spooky Season[/b] to Nordic Ashes! This event will last from [b]October 4th until November 3rd.
[/b]
[h2]Haunted Realms[/h2]

notes.title: New character: Lorcan
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!
At last, the day has come… new character is joining ranks!

[h1]New character: Lorcan[/h1]
Let’s welcome [b]Lorcan[/b], master of Luck! Lorcan the Conqueror, Lorcan founder of Lorcanism, Lorcan master of Dice… well, he may be a BIT narcissist. Just a tiny bit.
However, he won't show up until you [b]reach Vanaheim[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/44ee3cf1d3a9989be4e42630d4c288fba45284b1.png[/img]
*** SPOILER ALERT ***
If you didn't guess how to unlock Lorcan here is the answer:
[spoiler]He's quite fond of himself and loves it when people look up to him. Select Lorcan in the character selection panel and wait for 25 seconds to unlock him.[/spoiler]
[h2]Luck[/h2]
Lorcan’s will be introducing [b]Luck [/b]to Nordic Ashes.

Luck will determine if abilities based on % can have an extra roll. For example, if an effect would occur with 15% chance and it doesn't, with 1 Luck point you will gain an extra roll of 15% chance and therefore that effect will be more likely to occur.

Obviously, Lorcan will be Luck boosted so probabilities happen more often.
Relics affected by luck will have a clover icon next to them.

And of course, don't forget to check Lorcan's skins too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ddc08447f4142e7f899f5449232e062736d53fa5.png[/img]

[h2]New Relic: Lucky Clover[/h2]
This Lucky Clover will be your best friend when related to luck. You may unlock this relic thanks to Lorcan.

[h2]New Artifact: Lucky Coin[/h2]
When used, you will get 1 extra Luck Point temporarily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/f7a049d0c7964e13821fdf4d9e051e14fded82f2.png[/img]

[h1]New Daily Challenges[/h1]
10 new kinds of challenges have been added. You will find[b] new Blessings[/b] that will boost your runs.
We've also imporoved some of the existing challenges so they are more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/dd5a262a9a2cdf679bbbc75d13ed908ae88b868f.png[/img]

[h1]Yggdrasil[/h1]

We know many of you had some leaves left that wouldn't fit anywhere. With the addition of Lorcan, more leaves will be generated. To solve this issue, we've added a few new levels to existing perks such as crit. damage, movement speed, etc. A total of [b]120 new leaves to add to Yggdrasil[/b]!

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some curses would make you inflict negative damage and this could break the game. Minimum damage you will now inflict is 1.
[*] The Burden of Greed Curse will now reduce damage by 2.5% for each relic you own instead of 5%
[*] Some shrines could appear on top of you.
[*] Stats appearing on the left side of the screen have been reordered so they fit better on screen.
[*] Odin’s ravens could, in some cases, appear on Odin’s second phase.
[*] Dutch translations updated.
[*] Czech translations updated.
[/list]

[h1]Next steps[/h1]
On October we will be releasing a new [b]Halloween update[/b]. This time [b]Helheim[/b] will join Midgard with spooky decorations, both on the realm and on monsters. 
Halloween weapons will return and a one of the characters will get a new skin. [b]Can you guess who?
[/b]
We couldn't resist posting Malurt the Moth Queen on her Halloween costume. She looks much nicer this way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/76f0f90a82ebf4b35f694648cb3c069062099ace.png[/img]

[h2]Discount[/h2]
Nordic Ashes will be having a 2-week sale with 25% off!

We will be reading all your messages, suggestions and reports. Cheers! ːNA_Gnokiː

notes.title: Nordic Ashes OST + some fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!
We've been reading your comments these days, you've been amazing, thanks for supporting our game!

We will read all your comments no matter what, and we do appreciate it very much when you write constructive criticism or write feedback in a polite way. Thanks!

[h2]Nordic Ashes OST[/h2]
We're delighted to introduce Nordic Ashes Soundtrack! 
It features more than 50 minutes of music composed by Rubén Melià.
He worked really hard for a whole year, so we can experience 21 amazing tracks whenever we wish!

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949900/Nordic_Ashes_Soundtrack/ 

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[h2]Kaos fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Kaos’ ascension bug is now fixed.
[*] When ascending is possible, many ascending options will be displayed instead of just one.
[*] Kaos’ character mechanic was not working properly, as card points and level points should be the same thing. Each time you level up and use a card, points will be reduced too.
[/list]
[h2]Gnöki Badges[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Nordic Ashes 1.0 Launch
notes.notes:
Hello Vikings!
We’re delighted to present Nordic Ashes 1.0!!
[b]First of all, thanks so much for supporting us week after week since 2022![/b]

Let's dive into the new features:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Character Masteries[/h2]
As if Yggdrasil upgrades weren’t enough, let’s welcome Character Masteries!
You will earn xp each time you play with a character. This xp will be then exchanged for level points to upgrade that character. There will be 10 levels available to complete with each survivor.

If you’ve already played some runs with a character, you will be granted with xp points once you launch the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/b080ccc299d70b0fb8f153bc7252d7630870b322.png[/img]

[h2]Ragnarok X and extended Nightmare Mode[/h2]
[b]Ragnarok X[/b] will be the hardest and craziest challenge you will face on this 1.0 version! Let the madness begin!
In addition, you'll now be able to play [b]Nightmare[/b] mode extended to 12 waves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/d84ba080cbb040f496651eed97f702d729120d35.png[/img]

[h2]Secret character: KAOS[/h2]
And because it’s a secret, we won’t reveal anything. Will you be able to unlock it? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/7965287464933c9ed92ba2db0d2c9fbd0ca5109a.png[/img]

[h2]Character Dash[/h2]
This has been highly requested and we also felt it would suit characters very well and not just Hansi (his dash will still be more powerful than the regular ones).
Every character will have 1 dash charge available from the start. A second one can be unlocked in Yggdrasil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/41b39a67d6e2257f6bf6f4a6288ecd1c4312d07e.gif[/img]

[h2]2 new character skins[/h2]
Because we realized that after the addition of golden skins, Alruna and M.I.S.S.I.N.G. were lacking 1 skin, as all the other characters already had 4!
So here they are, an all white one and an all black one. We believe they suit them really well and hope you enjoy them too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/98c058b89b58c488d4231da284e46bb03a869174.png[/img]

[h2]Golden Attire [/h2]
Those golden badges from Daily Challenges finally have a purpose! You will be able to exchange them for Golden Skins. Every character will have their own. They will be available on the Daily Challenge panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/e008333524cc5eb12b606b49eacfa64305bf97df.png[/img]

[h2]Keybinding [/h2]
You will be able to reassign keys on PC, Xbox controller and PlayStation controller.

[h2]Save slots[/h2]
We’ve implemented a system where you can save, load or delete your game progress. This doesn’t mean you will be able to save in the middle of a run. This system is created in order to handle game data and backups.

[h2]Character wallpapers[/h2]
We wanted you to have high resolution wallpapers of every character! You may download them from this drive link so you can keep them :D
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kuZrPorp5MhdPDCHx4DOYyyU0qteNZc_?usp=sharing]Wallpapers link[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/96467f2fccbb6c233d63a6e34bdeae34a87dead0.png[/img]

[h1]New DLC releases[/h1]
[h2]Digital Artbook DLC - Now available[/h2]
At the beginning of the development this was a vague idea, but it kept turning more and more plausible each month. We thought maybe a 20-30 page artbook would be a nice thing to work on, but wow, it finally became a beautiful 100+ page artbook!
For now, you will be able to purchase it as a digital DLC, but if enough of us are willing to upgrade that version, we should create a hardcover version, right? Let us know what you think about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/eb928783c3933bf8edcfa25ec930c99186ecd00f.png[/img]

[h2]Soundtrack DLC - Coming soon[/h2]
Rubén Melià created this absolute masterpiece of original soundtrack for Nordic Ashes.
He worked really hard for a whole year, so you can experience 21 amazing tracks whenever you wish!
The soundtrack will be available as a Nordic Ashes DLC in a few days, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/41f4c7789023276f987241b6a5b9612acb819af8.png[/img]

[h2]Gnöki plush[/h2]
We got some news from Makeship! Gnöki campaign will be ready in a few weeks!!
You can subscribe though [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/crystal-keeper-gnoki-plush]this link[/url] for future updates or stay tuned here on Steam as we will post about it when it’s ready. 
Gnöki holding his ascension crystal will be ready to launch in no time… and we are really hyped about it! Here’s a sneak peek of how its looking and we already LOVE it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/9b1682dae946c38c4f1c6da5985733625236e6a8.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Axeldör's sword and axes rework.
[*] Alruna’s thunder visual rework.
[*] Hafgrim’s ultimate rework.
[*] Amaranth’s flower visual rework.
[*] Mead relic visual rework.
[*] Wave 1 is now shorter.
[*] Glossary items now show their rarity.
[*] “Soul Heart” and “Emerald Heart” have been reworded to Blue and Green so it’s not confusing.
[*] New Steam achievements.
[*] Xbox and Playstation controller icons added.
[*] Relic Exchanger now keeps relics from last run available.
[*] New relics related to dashes.
[*] Tutorials now include videos.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Talkôr’s bug that made him die even with gold is now fixed.
[*] In Asgard realm, if you didn’t defeat a raid shrine boss before before entering wave 5, it would follow you to the next wave instead of vanishing. This is now fixed. 
[*] If you attracted potions but some of them weren’t used because you already had full health, they would deactivate and stayed useless even if you lost health and tried to get them.
[*] Lights Curse bug. If you died and revived just before entering Gnöki’s realm while having the Lights Curse activated on that run, light beams were still on in the shop.
[*] Some relics were hitting enemies twice in some cases, like Amaranth’s Chilli.
[/list]
[h1]Future steps[/h1]
Nordic Ashes journey will not end today. We already have new content planned for the future, so don't worry, we're not going anywhere. Let's keep in touch! For now, let's enjoy 1.0 release! ːNA_Crystalː


Thanks again for your amazing support!!
If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, don't hesitate to contact us:

notes.title: Asgard Realm
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

[h1]Asgard Realm[/h1]
Today’s the day! Finally, the last realm, [b]Asgard, is live![/b]
We couldn’t be happier about it, it’s been a long journey and we are very grateful for you all, for your support, feedback and everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/af344243b78906f770a39d04899ec1bd3ae6edf0.png[/img]
Asgard realm is a bit different from the others. You will fight the most known gods of Norse Mythology including [b]Loki, Thor…![/b] We’ve been wanting to develop them since day one :D

This realm will also include a [b]5th wave[/b] to make things more epic. Expert mode will also have a surprise at the end. We won’t spoil much more so you can explore this realm by yourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/5ac6ede32f3dafc886059acd6b3ae5a3cd7a2595.png[/img]

And now, what we all have been waiting for… future steps! Release date! New content! A new Gnöki plush?!
Let’s go one by one:

[h1]Release date: April 26th[/h1]
Mark your calendars for [b]April 26th[/b]! Nordic Ashes 1.0 will be out that day and we want to deliver the best game possible! So let’s do it! ːNA_Gnokiː

[h2]New content[/h2]
We are going to take a couple of months before the official release date so we can [b]polish [/b]everything, redraw some things, etc.
[list]
[*] More relics
[*] New Character
[*] Game balancing
[*] Rework of some artifacts
[*] QoL
[*] Secrets
[*] & more!
[/list]
And we will be [b]reading your suggestions[/b] so feel free to add them to the Steam forums or Discord.

[h2]Asgard Ragnarok and Nightmare[/h2]
We will update next week with this two game modes so they are complete.

[h2]Gnöki Plush[/h2]
Many of you have written to us asking how to get a Gnöki plush. As the past campaign was a success, we will be releasing a new version of the Gnöki plush, based on the illustration below. We’re really hyped about it! More details in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/9ff6d28159c1a8adf91a1f39c97026b44a91883c.png[/img]

[h2]Dark Knight Skins[/h2]
Long time ago we decided these skins would be Early Access Exclusive, but after reading your feedback (and thank you for the people who write polite feedback) we’ve decided to make them permanent, just as the event skins.
However, just as themed skins, it will be easier to get them before 1.0 as a thank you for the early support of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/db0ec6bd923bff9b9acc0fdc0abc9e177ce67a5d.png[/img]

[h1]Price increase[/h1]
It will be 2 years of development the day we release the game. We never imagined this game would turn out so big. We love reading comments and watching people that have played for 1hour, 10 hours… more than a 100 hours?! It’s so amazing!
And for all this content and effort developing the game we firmly believe that the price should be increased. Its future price will change [b]from 4.99$ to most likely, 8.99$[/b]. This will happen on [b]March 25th.[/b]

If you want to get it at a discounted price, [b]we have a 20% discount running until Feb 24th[/b], and Spring Sale will still be there before the price increase, so you can still grab it at a lower price then.

[h2]News updates[/h2]
We won’t be updating the game after next week. But as always, we’d like to keep you informed about our progress and what we’re developing. So expect a News post every two weeks or so.

[h2]Future DLCs[/h2]
On the release date, we will have 2 DLCs available: Artbook and Soundtrack. Both of them will be available on the store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/a127a2244ecb7e6c87088c4b5fde02015053c688.png[/img]

And after release, we will start working on content DLCs! We still have many ideas we’d like to add to the game that would suit very well as DLCs.

And I think that’s all for today, that was a long post! 

Here’s a shot version in case you didn’t want to read that much :P
TLDR:
[list]
[*] Asgard, the last realm is live.
[*] 1.0 Release Date: April 26th.
[*] We will be posting news with new content being developed until that day.

notes.title: Update v.0.13.9
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

Today as promised, we have a seed update! ːNA_Seedː ːNA_Seedː ːNA_Seedː
There’s always a moment where you don’t know what to do with your seeds anymore, so we needed to do something about it. And even if you still haven’t exchanged all the available leaves for seeds, we think you will enjoy this update very much too!

[h2]Seed plants[/h2]
The first announcement is that you will find seed plants across the realms! That way you will be able to earn many more seeds on each run. Hit them a few times to earn seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bb573eb6738a9058f76a8df95ec686caff316cd7.png[/img]

One of the reasons is that this way you can get a bunch of leaves faster, and the other one goes as follows:

[h2]Relic Exchange:[/h2]
You will find a new [b]tab on the main menu called Relic Exchange[/b]. In this panel you will be able [b]exchange some of your seeds for relics which will appear at the beginning of your next run[/b]. These relics can be active and passive relics, but not Ancestral relics in any case (the ones belonging to each character). Up to 15 relics will appear.

You will see relic seed prices vary depending on their rarity. Each relic will also have an energy cost. You will be able to add up to 5 relics depending on their energy.
This way you may get 5 commons, or 2 epics, or 1 common 1 legendary, etc.
For a small amount of seeds you will be able to reroll the weapons that appeared. 
You may also lock relics by previously selecting them so they don’t reroll with the rest.
Once you’re done, just close the panel and the relics you selected will appear right when you start a new run.
[b]These relics will only be available until your next run ends, so choose wisely.[/b]

You will need to earn 10k seeds to unlock this feature. 

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ragnarok VI and VII added to Custom Mode.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Immunity Knot relic didn't avoid you getting frozen in Jotunheim.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new seed features!

As for next week, we will open Asgard beta! The last beta realm of the game!
Seed you soon :D ːNA_Seedː

notes.title: Update v0.13.7
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

We're back after a few days off :D
While we develop Asgard we will also update every week with some content, mostly QoL.

On today's update you will find the following:

[h2]Difficulty[/h2]
We’ve been working on optimizing early stages difficulty. This way new players won’t find the first realms too hard and the [b]learning curve will be much smoother[/b]. This will apply to Midgard, Alfheim, Svartalfheim and Jotunheim.

Another realm that was too hard in comparison to the rest was [b]Muspelheim[/b], so we lowered their  HP and speed. If it still feels decompensated, please let us know.

[h2]Minimap[/h2]
Structures are now shown in the mini map from the beginning of the adventure. This means that the Yggdrasil slot that upgraded this feature will be removed. This will help new players learn there are many areas you can interact with. And it’s also a good aid for any player!

[h2]Ascensions[/h2]
You will now be able to ascend relics WHENEVER you want. They no longer have to be level 10. We believe this will make runs more fun and flexible.

[b]Disclaimer: [/b]remember R.E.S.E.T. relic will reset your weapons back to level 1 when ascended. This means that, while owning R.E.S.E.T. during a run, if you reach level 10 and ascend your relic, it will have a total of 20 levels (nothing changes here). But if you ascend at level 3, your relic will only have a total of 13 levels.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Relics that do not synergize with those you own or your character can get in their constellation, will not appear in the shop or on shrines. For example: if you don’t have any thunder relics, passive relics related to thunder will not appear. This will happen as long as there are enough relics in the pool. If not, they will begin to appear.
[*] Gold mine shrine visually upgraded.
[*] UI changes on how many seeds you have in exchange for leaves in the Yggdrasil panel.
[*] UI changes related to the Constellation.
[*] The distribution of xp between regular mobs and elites has been homogenized in wave 1 to make leveling up easier.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Yggdrasil tree leaves should not reset anymore.
[*] In some cases, if doing a Daily Challenge from a realm you had not yet unlocked, many achievements were unlocked when they shouldn’t.
[*] Axeldör’s Thunder Armor 1st ascension was not working properly.
[*] Alfheim explosive slimes telegraph was not working properly.
[*] Alfheim saplings telegraph was not working properly.
[/list]

See you next week!

notes.title: Update v0.13.6
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!!

Today we have a few improvements, challenging levels and a surprise we're sure you'll love!

[h2]Ragnarok Mode[/h2]
Ragnarok levels will be available for all realms! We had the following left:
Ragnarok I-VII in Niflheim and in Muspelheim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/076b3e49ec137a77cf27da2428b1671d60a0f59c.png[/img]

[h2]Nightmare Mode[/h2]
We're also adding the rest of Nightmare mode realms! These are Niflheim and Muspelheim realms too. Ice and Fire Nightmares!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/47ae04c99433ddc26e121b552a3dd3dd73dd1812.png[/img]

[h2]New Shrine![/h2]
The gold mine has arrived at Nordic Ashes! This new shrine is exactly that, a place where gold will be mined second after second. For now, it will provide 1 gold coin every 30 seconds. You don’t need to do anything, just grab the money whenever you want. (I’m sure there will be an Yggdrasil upgrade at some point, but shhh).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c7ab8cd16c53319127af653f949e604ef2795c9d.png[/img]

[h2]Anniversary Skins for Blud and Alruna[/h2]
Last friday, December 15th was our 1 year anniversary since we launched Early Access! And what a better way to celebrate than to add Anniversary Skins for the remaining characters!
Yes, that's right! Blud and Alruna will now have their own Anniversary Skin! It will work as last time: conquer 3 realms with those characters to win their skins :D (these are all permanent skins).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/550e8fff6913400a02dd504d337da13a3af7548e.png[/img]

[h2]Skins from past events[/h2]
Thanks all your feedback, we've decided to create new ways of getting character skins from past events in case you missed them.
You will now be able to get Amaranth Catrina skin by winning 5 runs with Amaranth. If you already have, your skin will be automatically unlocked.

Same will happen with Santa Talkor. Once the event is over (Jan 4th) you will be able to unlock it too.

We hope that with these changes, you won't feel FOMO or not being able to earn every achievement.
We will still keep part of the events as seasonal ones, because we think it's fun to have some variety. For example, Halloween Midgard will be available on October. But that's just as it happens in real life, everything is decorated in a spooky way only during October.

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
Since now you can get all the skins, we've created a new achievement for each of them ːNA_Crystalː

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The quantity of enemies needed to obtain leaves has been reduced.
[*] Bosses and Final Bosses now grant more seeds.
[*] Max. seeds required in exchange for leaves has been reduced from 500 to 450.
[*] Seed drop rate has been increased.
[*] Players will now earn 5 leaves on their first run.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Axeldör’s Fire Boots (Brann) second ascension was not working.
[*] End panel scroll improvements.
[/list]
[h2]Happy Holidays![/h2]
This will be the last update of the year as we will be taking 2 weeks off to rest all the new Asgard ideas and come back strong In January! We want to take all the time that requires to honor the last realm.
We hope you enjoy these holidays very much.

From the bottom of our hearts, we wish you the best and an amazing 2024! You are the best community ever! ːNA_Gnokiː

notes.notes:
Hello!!
In today’s update we wanted to focus in some suggestions and fixes you sent us. And new Ragnaroks too!

[h2]Helheim Ragnarok VI & VII[/h2]
We’ve added Ragnarok VI and VII to Helheim. Let us know how it feels! We know this mode was quite complicated last time, but it was due to a few bugs that were solved some weeks ago, so this ones should be plausible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/3eff3017a3d171d654761ad123cf8c4abded7014.png[/img]

[h2]Niflheim Ragnarok I-V[/h2]
We've also added Ragnarok I-V in Niflheim! So you can enjoy hardcore runs in this cold weather!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c2a50be825ed14703c74e48ac750e7c0147ca96f.png[/img]

[h2]Suggestions[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Ultimate ability input has been improved. The icon shown in the bottom left of the screen will now glow each time it’s available. 
[*] Alpha settings can now be modified with keyboard and controller. Keyboard pressing I/O and controller with up/down directional buttons.
[*] After an enemy is defeated, the dissolving animation lenght has been reduced, so enemies you defeat disappear quicker.
[*] In manual aim, the direction of your attacks is now displayed.
[/list]
[h2]Regarding FOMO[/h2]
We’ve been reading your comments about FOMO in the last post, and thank you for commenting and doing it as constructive criticism, we really appreciate when feedback is written in a constructive way 😊
Our idea with themed skins or events has always been to add some variety to Nordic Ashes, but we understand your concerns. We will work on a solution to avoid this issue.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] In some cases Yggdrasil leaves would reset. 
[*] The Snowman relic and the Pinecone’s shadow were not affected by the alpha settings.
[*] In some boss fights the music stopped playing.
[*] When activating the use of the mouse to move the character, manual aim was autoactivated. Now aim will be automatic.
[*] Constellation UI texts were sometimes overlapped.
[/list]
Thanks again for your feedback, comments and love ːNA_Gnokiː

notes.title: Update v0.13.2
notes.notes:
Hello! ːNA_Leafː
Today we have a suggestions/fixes update related to your feedback :D

[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[list]
[*] If you touch the Gnöki Exchange Shrine (the one in the shop, that exchanges xp for gold) once and then step away, it will exchange xp for gold 1 time. But if you stay close, it will exchange xp for gold multiple times, faster each time. 
[*] If you already have the maximum gold, it won’t keep exchanging xp for nothing even if you stay close.
[*] This exchange shrine will also appear in the room before the final boss.
[*] Changed the color of the timer that appears on the bottom center of the screen during runs so you can see it better.
[*] You can now hide the UI during runs in case you want to take a screenshot pressing F9 or the left joystick. 
[*] Manual aim (mouse): we’ve slightly changed how it works and we hope it is now more intuitive. It will aim at you enemies while you keep it pressed.
[*] Green hearts will now appear always in last position. This way you will lose them first when you get hit, as they grant you xp when they break.
[/list]
[h2]Alruna balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] To make unlocking her more intuitive, it will now be on Niflheim Realm. As ice potions are unlocked in this realm, it will make things more straight forward.
[*] And speaking of Ice Potions. We’ve also changed the probability of them appearing on the shop, so they are easier to obtain. Before, red potions were Common and the others were Rare. Now they all have the same % of appearing.
[*] Her weapon Selenite Wand, has now manual aim too.
[*] If your character has earned penetration stats, Selenite Wand will have them too.
[*] Alruna’s Ultimate ability: she will summon one extra Gunborg every 5 summons on her global stats.
[*] The Mandrake’s cry area is now larger.
[*] Splintered Bones have now a larger area. Their initial duration has been changed from 2 to 3.
[*] Splintered Bones caused bleeding, but it was not specified in their description. Now it is.
[*] Updated Alruna’s minions descriptions.
[/list]
[h2]Hansi balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crimson Dagger had a random target. It now targets nearby enemies.
[*] Deep Crystal now starts with 2 projectiles instead of 1 and the area of effect is larger. It also targets enemies more efficiently.
[*] Shadow Crossbow has now faster projectiles but they last less and have less attack speed. It now targets the closest enemies.
[*] Shadow Warrior also targets now the closest enemies.
[/list]
[h2]Effects visibility tutorial[/h2]
We’ve added a new tutorial. In case your abilities crowd the screen and you can’t see what’s below them (the ground, your enemies…), you can always reduce their alpha so they become more transparent and you can see through them.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] There was a know bug that made some bosses or enemies immortal. This should now be fixed.
[*] Alruna’s Splintered Bones relic was not aiming correctly.
[*] Sometimes, Alruna’s stats regarding her innate ability were not being added correctly when you leveled up.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update!
Next week we will introduce [b]Winter Season!![/b]
Have a nice day and see you very soon! ːNA_Crystalː

notes.title: Muspelheim Realm
notes.notes:
Good morning/evening/night!
Today is the day we release the 8th realm!! ːNA_Expertː ːNA_Crystalː

[h2]Muspelheim[/h2]
On Muspelheim you will find tons of demons, black stone golems and many Logi enemies! (Logi meaning “fire” in Old Norse).
Face three new challenging bosses and become a master of this volcanic area!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/852a561c873eba9aaf058379d2bdd6e7ac924081.png[/img]

[h2]Floor is Lava[/h2]
This realm’s mechanic goes as follows: “the Floor is Lava” which explains itself perfectly ːNA_Hardː. Each time you place your foot inside a lava pool, your burning indicator will rise, and no one wants to experience what happens when it reaches its maximum, thank you very much.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/fc8958da913f2e305b8ad84afe73612b98aff1b7.png[/img]

[h2]Burning Heart[/h2]
We also added a new kind of heart, the Burning Heart. This heart will explode when you receive damage and release fire balls that damage your enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/f372be31c3568eb9a0fabe988dbc1ccc94704531.png[/img]

[h2]New Dragon Egg Shrine[/h2]
Muspelheim will allow you to unlock a new kind of shrine. A dragon egg will spawn at the begining of the run. After 15 minutes it will hatch and reveal a [b]Legendary item as a reward[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/25dea783cba227e478c8f10d50755a1b0d73ab72.png[/img]

[h2]Fire Relics[/h2]
And of course, a new set of relics, all related to this new realm!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/2b82fc2e16169ddea1b6adf470620b7d2361ee94.png[/img]

[h2]Niflheim Soundtrack[/h2]
Rubén Meliá did it again! We're so happy to announce that Niflheim tracks are now available and you can enjoy them while playing! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/fe3d0340f32278766b312014ef7659c5063b5143.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Helheim elite Red Cranium's health was bugged when it divided.
[*] Ice balls, Burning Projectiles and Poison Projectiles where aiming into wrong directions.
[*] Elites stopped appearing in high Ragnarok levels.
[*] Final Boss Jord anims have been slightly modified.
[*] Final Boss Hel's pillars shouldn't have that much HP now.
[*] Minor fixes related to bosses behavior.
[/list]

[h2]New character next week[/h2]
Next week you will meet Alruna, our new survivor. Any guesses?? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/38e1773d318f1be93f2e491ce6e2442ddc3aa0ea.png[/img]

[h2]20% off to celebrate Muspelheim realm![/h2]
That's it! Let's embrace fire with a nice discount :D

[h2]We’re almost there![/h2]
It’s an awkward feeling, just 1 realm left…! (but there’s still a lot of content we will be publishing so no worries cause we aint going anywhere else yet!).

Let us know what you think!
Cheers!

[h2]How to access the Beta?[/h2]
[b]REMEMBER[/b]: To play the beta, you will need to have purchased Nordic Ashes previously.
[olist]
[*] Open the Steam application.
[*] Go to the Steam library and select Nordic Ashes. 
[*] Right click on it and select Properties.
[*] A panel will open, select the Beta option.
[*] Enter the following code: [b]NordicAshesBeta[/b]
[*] Click the button to verify that it is correct.
[*] If everything is OK, you will have the Beta option in the drop-down menu. Select it and the game will be updated.
[/olist]
[h3]Beta Information[/h3]
Thank you very much for helping us improve the game. You are an amazing community 😄
First of all, we’d like to share the following disclaimer [b](don’t forget to read #8)[/b]

[olist]
[*] Keep in mind that this is a Beta and therefore it may contain bugs and balancing issues.
[*] The purpose of the Beta is that you have access to an early version of the game, so you can help us to fix bugs, balance the game and give suggestions.
[*] The Betas last for a certain period of time. We will release them as new updates are released. This particular one will be open for 1 week.
[*] There is a specific discussion for beta feedback in Steam.
[*] The Beta progress will be saved in your actual account.
[*] You can unlock the Steam achievements already published, but the new ones that will be released will not be available. However, once the Beta version is released, you will receive all achievements you have already earned.
[*] You may upload or stream Beta content if you wish. However, please add a disclaimer to your videos/streams to announce that it is the Beta you are playing, not the public version of the game.
[*] [b]IMPORTANT[/b]: To avoid any loss of your progress please follow the next steps:
         a.    Create a backup of your saving files just in case. There should be no issues but just to be safe please do. You may find them here: 
                 i.    windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
                 ii.    macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/com.NoxfallStudios.NordicAshes/Backup
                 iii.    linux: ~/.config/unity3d/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
         b.    After playing the Beta, if you wish to return to the main version of the game and deactivate the Beta, please notice that your Beta progress will be lost.
[/olist]

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]
It is possible that you find bugs or content that has yet to be implemented, such as sounds. We thank you for notifying us of any bug or issue through our discord or steam discussions, in the specific Beta section. This way we can access all the information and fix any issues. Thank you so much!

notes.title: Spooky Season is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings vikings!
And welcome to [b]Nordic Ashes Spooky Season[/b]! ːNA_Normalː

Beginning today, [b]October 1st until November 2nd[/b] we are celebrating pumpkin spice and embracing darkness (very dramatic).

As we did last year, Midgard will be decorated with pumpkins and spiderwebs. Spooky themed Relics will make an appearance again, this time with their own ascensions (can you believe last year we didn’t have any ascensions at all? So much has changed ːNA_Gnokiː)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/61b30218c966726bf9df281ee0bc7d2c90257c4d.png[/img]
 
Please notice that themed relics will appear more often than regular ones. 
On that note, you may disable the Halloween event on the Settings panel if you prefer to play regular runs.

And of course, we couldn’t publish a Halloween update with just a little bit of content. We wanted to go BIG and decided to create a new character and a spooky character skin to join our family! We also designed these beautiful[b] wallpapers [/b]so you can download them and keep them!

[h2]New Character: BLUD![/h2]
Hidden inside a tombstone, a malignant creature has awakened… 
With a new set of skills and his own way of surviving, Blud came here to disrupt Ragnarok and beat up some monsters!

This is also [b]our tribute to Vampire Survivors[/b], the game that made this genre accessible to millions of players! We hope you enjoy Blud and his easter egg-ish way of unlocking him! ːNA_RedHeartː

As much as Blud can be Halloween related, this is NOT part of the Spooky season, the release dates simply coincided. This means he is a permanent character and you will always be able to unlock him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/8dd2cd38549198f15d68817444ba0a7e5a655953.png[/img]

[h2]Amaranth Catrina[/h2]
Welcome Amaranth and all her plant fellows dressed up as terrific monsters :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bc94ea0f3b4aee66f7860a77ad9483b2f21f27a9.png[/img]
 

We hope you enjoy this update, we had so much fun designing the all new content ːNA_Crystalː

First of all, new Realm available: Niflheim! This is the realm where everything started. Its deep layers of ice make it the coldest realm on Norse mythology.

[h2]How to access the Beta?[/h2]
[b]REMEMBER[/b]: To play the beta, you will need to have purchased Nordic Ashes previously.
[olist]
[*] Open the Steam application.
[*] Go to the Steam library and select Nordic Ashes. 
[*] Right click on it and select Properties.
[*] A panel will open, select the Beta option.
[*] Enter the following code: [b]NordicAshesBeta[/b]
[*] Click the button to verify that it is correct.
[*] If everything is OK, you will have the Beta option in the drop-down menu. Select it and the game will be updated.
[/olist]
[h3]Beta Information[/h3]
Thank you very much for helping us improve the game. You are an amazing community 😄
First of all, we’d like to share the following disclaimer (don’t forget to read #8)

[olist]
[*] Keep in mind that this is a Beta and therefore it may contain bugs and balancing issues.
[*] The purpose of the Beta is that you have access to an early version of the game, so you can help us to fix bugs, balance the game and give suggestions.
[*] The Betas last for a certain period of time. We will release them as new updates are released. This particular one will be open for 1 week.
[*] There is a specific discussion for beta feedback in Steam.
[*] The Beta progress will be saved in your actual account.
[*] You can unlock the Steam achievements already published, but the new ones that will be released will not be available. However, once the Beta version is released, you will receive all achievements you have already earned.
[*] You may upload or stream Beta content if you wish. However, please add a disclaimer to your videos/streams to announce that it is the Beta you are playing, not the public version of the game.
[*] [b]IMPORTANT[/b]: To avoid any loss of your progress please follow the next steps:
         a.    Create a backup of your saving files just in case. There should be no issues but just to be safe please do. You may find them here: 
                 i.    windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
                 ii.    macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/com.NoxfallStudios.NordicAshes/Backup
                 iii.    linux: ~/.config/unity3d/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
         b.    After playing the Beta, if you wish to return to the main version of the game and deactivate the Beta, please notice that your Beta progress will be lost.
[/olist]

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]
It is possible that you find bugs or content that has yet to be implemented, such as sounds. We thank you for notifying us of any bug or issue through our discord or steam discussions, in the specific Beta section. This way we can access all the information and fix any issues. Thank you so much!

notes.title: Performance upgrade + Nightmare Mode
notes.notes:
Hello vikings! New Thursday, new update!

[h2]Performance boost[/h2]
Great news! Performance has been increased so much since the beginning of summer! Thanks for your patience. After implementing all these changes, we will now be able to update every week as usual! This will make all runs go smoother even when you equip many weapons with large areas, projectile speed, etc.

[h2]Vanaheim Ragnarok[/h2]
Raganarok mode is now available on Vanaheim too! This means you’ll be able to play 5 new challenging levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/3b26726ebea525a1b7f48d293fb1074d070ef76b.png[/img]

[h2]Nightmare Mode[/h2]
After months of coding, performance improvements are finally working! 
Nightmare mode[b] will mimic Endless.[/b] Here’s how it works: 

On today’s update, Nightmare mode will have [b]9 waves available[/b]. If everything runs smoothly (which it should) we will be able to [b]increase [/b]the number of waves each time we improve performance. So expect 12 waves in future updates. 
We want the player experience to be fun and without lag, and that’s why we’ve decided to “twist” Endless and be sure performance works fine as we provide lengthier runs many players enjoy. 

[list]
[*] For now, it will only be available on Midgard. We will expand it to the other realms in the future.
[*] Nightmare mode runs will feature a darker shade so it feels more nightmareish.
[*] Each cycle will comprise 3 waves (we skipped wave 1 of regular runs).
[*] Endless Curse is now called Nightmare Curse. Each time you reach Gnöki’s realm, prices will increase 25% instead of 50% as they did before until they reach a maximum of 150% instead of 250%
[*] Each time a Curse appears, it will be displayed on screen.
[*] After completing 1 cycle (after final boss) shrines will keep appearing and this time they will provide you with runes.
[*] We’ve also reduced the length of each wave 20% so runs feel more dynamic.
[/list]

As always, if you spot any bugs or issues, please write them on this thread so we can check them out and fix them as soon as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/f2d6885482ef7e160b18b3e895051ae5b98e9727.png[/img]

[h2]5 New Relics[/h2]
Hansi will be able to unlock these relics that will work really nice with crits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/de4caf0f71182cb2ddd58a237f96d265fac7ea86.png[/img]

[h2]Bugs and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gnöki Coupon achievement should now appear in your list after completing it.
[*] Crystal Enhancer relics won’t be suitable for selling to Olga anymore.

notes.title: Performance Beta - Endless Testing
notes.notes:
Hello!
Good news! After weeks and weeks of wrecking our brains (and code), at last we have many improvements! That means new performance Beta is now available!

Here’s what you will find:
[list]
[*] Major code changes. This means enemy movement may have varied a little. You may also find a slightly different feeling on collisions and projectiles too.
[*] This beta will only have Midgard available.
[*] As we only have Midgard, Raid Shrines and Challenge mode will be disabled.
[*] Endless Mode enabled once again. Let us know how it feels!
[*] General performance improvements. Now you can expect your Endless and Ragnarok runs with a higher fps rate.
[*] You’ll have the same progress as your current version.
[*] On this particular beta, your [b]progress won’t be saved[/b] to prevent possible errors. This also means there will be no issue going back and forth between your current version and the beta.
[*] Please notice that we have changed quite a bit of code, and are still tweaking some things, so you may find some bugs or issues during your run (let’s hope very few). Please report any weird things you may spot!
[/list]
We can’t wait to hear your feedback! This is a very important beta for Nordic Ashes game. If everything runs correctly, we will proceed to update the live version of the game next week (or the next one, depending on feedback and fixes!).

[h2]Indie Dev Day[/h2]
We are so happy to attend Indie Dev Day in Barcelona this weekend. It’s a really important event hosted by Devolver and it will be our second event showcasing Nordic Ashes with our own stand! 
If any of you are around Barcelona, come and say hi 😄

Wish you a great rest of the week!
Cheers!

If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, don't hesitate to contact us:
🔸 [url=https://discord.gg/RhdgScwtm9]Discord[/url].
🔸 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2068280/discussions/]Steam Community[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068280/Nordic_Ashes_Survivors_of_Ragnarok/


[h2]How to access the Beta?[/h2]
[b]REMEMBER[/b]: To play the beta, you will need to have purchased Nordic Ashes previously.
[olist]
[*] Open the Steam application.
[*] Go to the Steam library and select Nordic Ashes. 
[*] Right click on it and select Properties.
[*] A panel will open, select the Beta option.
[*] Enter the following code: [b]NordicAshesBeta[/b]
[*] Click the button to verify that it is correct.
[*] If everything is OK, you will have the Beta option in the drop-down menu. Select it and the game will be updated.
[/olist]
[h3]Beta Information[/h3]
Thank you very much for helping us improve the game. You are an amazing community 😄
First of all, we’d like to share the following disclaimer (don’t forget to read #8)

[olist]
[*] Keep in mind that this is a Beta and therefore it may contain bugs and balancing issues.
[*] The purpose of the Beta is that you have access to an early version of the game, so you can help us to fix bugs, balance the game and give suggestions.
[*] The Betas last for a certain period of time. We will release them as new updates are released. This particular one will be open for 1 week.
[*] There is a specific discussion for beta feedback in Steam.
[*] The Beta progress will be saved in your actual account.
[*] You can unlock the Steam achievements already published, but the new ones that will be released will not be available. However, once the Beta version is released, you will receive all achievements you have already earned.
[*] You may upload or stream Beta content if you wish. However, please add a disclaimer to your videos/streams to announce that it is the Beta you are playing, not the public version of the game.
[*] [b]IMPORTANT[/b]: To avoid any loss of your progress please follow the next steps:
         a.    Create a backup of your saving files just in case. There should be no issues but just to be safe please do. You may find them here: 
                 i.    windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
                 ii.    macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/com.NoxfallStudios.NordicAshes/Backup
                 iii.    linux: ~/.config/unity3d/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
         b.    After playing the Beta, if you wish to return to the main version of the game and deactivate the Beta, please notice that your Beta progress will be lost.
[/olist]

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]
It is possible that you find bugs or content that has yet to be implemented, such as sounds. We thank you for notifying us of any bug or issue through our discord or steam discussions, in the specific Beta section. This way we can access all the information and fix any issues. Thank you so much!

Greetins vikings!

We’re back! After a few weeks off we’re ready to rock and roll again!
In today’s update we have gone through some of your suggestions such as highly requested manual aim or the unfortunate bug that made some bosses invulnerable.

[b]We still need to review many of your comments, so expect a new update in the following weeks with more of your suggestions and fixing things you commented on the Steam forums and on Discord. 
Thank you thank you, we love this developer-player interaction so much :D[/b]

[h2]Manual aim[/h2]
Wow it’s been so long since many of you asked for a manual aim feature and here it is!
You will see some Relics have now a manual aim (which can be set as auto-aim too in case you prefer so in the settings panel). This way, Relics such as Thyra’s daggers will fire at the enemies you're aiming to. You will find a target icon next to the relics that have manual aim. Some of them are Axeldör’s sword and hammer, Thyra’s bow and daggers or Helga’s cards.
Let us know what you think about this new feature!

[h3]About Endless and performance improvements[/h3]
We are currently working on many performance improvements. One of them is changing drastically some programming elements so you can experience a much better performance, even in lower end devices.
Our goal with these changes is that we won’t need to nerf any character abilities and the game will perform pretty well with crazy builds.
We still need to polish the programming, but Endless Mode will be a blast when it’s ready!

[*] Steam Deck tooltip texts are now displayed properly.
[*] Bosses should not remain invulnerable all the time.
[*] You can now scroll between characters and realms in their selection panels with the mouse scroll wheel.
[*] Hansi could get stuck in Gnoki's Realm due to his dash. This shouldn’t happen anymore.
[*] Elite enemies weren't dropping XP in certain cases when the restriction of not dropping chests was activated.

notes.title: Nordic Ashes Anniversary
notes.notes:
Good day vikings!
Today we are celebrating 1 Year since we launched the Nordic Ashes Demo whoop whoop!! This will be a nice and lengthy post, but filled with love and positive energy ofc [b](and surprises)[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c2a4bd11ba501ae0359fbec0d83cc8664f2cc0be.png[/img]

And nothing of this would be real if it wasn’t for you! So we want to thank you once again for your amazing support, all your comments and great ideas! We are so happy to have been able to implement many of the suggestions you have made. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ab5bb8b3ffcd908f157fdbf560f3d05082f5c35b.png[/img]

Many of you already know our team a little bit, but for those who don’t, we wish to introduce ourselves :D

We are Noxfall Studios, an independent team of 3 developers. Each of us specializes in one field but we also do a bit of everything else (copyrighting texts, managing translations, social networks etc). We’re happy to do it this way, that way we can manage everything from the inside and make our own decisions.

[b]Axeldör[/b], is the game director. He came up with the idea of this game after enjoying survivor games during this childhood days and later playing other games such as Vampire Survivors. He’s programmer and designer and is always thinking about new ways to improve the game and create new mechanics for every new character and boss.

[b]Fengos[/b], programmer and designer, will always be sure everything is perfectly placed in each realm. He also does a lot of testing, which is essential during the development.

[b]Naya[/b] is our community manager, but on top of all, our 2D artist. Everything you see in-game has been drawn and designed by her: characters, enemies, props, UI… literally everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ebc9f1b8fa106db4c12da1d0b477b786f97225d7.png[/img]

[h2]Anniversary Skins[/h2]
Oh, and the surprise… we’ve designed an exclusive skin for every character!! That means 8 skins total in this new update!

The way of unlocking them is pretty easy, you must beat 3 different realms with each character to earn their skin. notes.title: Update v0.10.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Todays update comes with 2 new Game Modes and balances overall difficulty of the game.

[h2]Daily Challenge[/h2]
Find a new challenge every day. In this new game mode, you will be able to compete with other players to see who makes the best time or just challenge yourself and see how far you can go. 
This game mode has the following features:
[list]
[*] All players will play in the same conditions, same shrines, relics, survivor, realm, etc...
[*] We want everyone to have the same opportunities, therefore, all content is unlocked. However, you won’t be able to unlock new content for your regular runs or the glossary.
[*] You will be rewarded with 500 extra seeds and a Gnöki Badge the first time you complete a challenge each day.
[*] These runs have restrictions, such as no shrines or crates among others. Curses, Enemy Modifiers and Enemy Abilities may appear, making the run more challenging.
[*] In return, you will be aided by powerful blessings that will grant unique abilities.
[*] You will have a specific Yggdrasil each day, with a 100 leaves to spend.
[*] Leaderboard will be updated every day at 00:00 UTC.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bf6c06f8444a8c0cf4233cb017991883c5e7a74d.png[/img]
In future updates we will be releasing new Blessings, Curses and Restrictions. As always, we will be happy to read all your suggestions and ideas to create new content!

[h2]Custom Mode[/h2]
Many of you have been asking for the possibility of making a run with your own custom parameters and being able to ban relics, so here we go! 
First, choose a survivor, realm and difficulty. 
Then, you will be able to set some restrictions, such as disabling Yggdrasil or not being able to ascend, among others.

And what you were all waiting for… We have added the possibility of banning relics, as many as you want (you must have unlocked them in the Glossary and picked them up in a run at least once).

The seed drop % will vary depending on the restrictions and bans you have chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ffafb400347bd5ed46aed4fd11ad37af21d999fc.png[/img]

We will be adding new parameters with which you will be able to customize your game in future updates. Please feel free to add any suggestions in the comments below! 


[h2]Difficulty balancing[/h2]
We have readjusted the difficulty of all Realms as there are still 4 to come and we don’t want the game to feel impossible to beat lol. Enemy health in both Jotunheim and Vanaheim was too high compared to previous stages. This will make Ragnarok difficulty scale better too.

Bosses in Rage mode won’t have their movement speed or size increased anymore. The only stat that will increase will be the damage they deal. 

We have also reduced enemy Giantism ability and reduced the speed at which they grow. It is now limited to a maximum, preventing bosses from getting extremely large.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Legendary Relic Beam Pyramid damage was not being tracked.
[*] Pause panel tooltips were not being displayed properly. 
[*] Tooltips were not being displayed properly.
[*] After defeating a Raid Shrine boss there was a bug with the music.
[*] In-game glossary was not working properly
[/list]

If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, don't hesitate to contact us:

🔸 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2068280/discussions/]Steam Community[/url].

notes.title: Update v0.10.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today’s update is all about Beta Challenge Mode.
This new mode will be a challenge for those who want to push their gameplay further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/27b56b2b412d2f127030de7b9322969f3085a438.png[/img]

Every day you will have the opportunity to play a new run, completely different from any other. This run will be the same for everyone. That means you will play with the same character, same starting relic, same shrines and rewards, etc.

In case you haven’t unlocked a character or relic, that won’t be an issue as everything will be unlocked on Challenge Mode.

As the aim of this game mode is that everyone has the same opportunities, your Yggdrasil will be disabled. However, there will be a few random upgrades available each day. Today is the day! New realm, new enemies, new achievements, and original soundtrack announcement among others!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/22ed1e00af6801142ceed4c0a68ad950f81db90b.png[/img]

[h2]Vanaheim[/h2]
Vanaheim is the land of the Vanir gods. Here you will find many elemental creatures that will try their best to defend their kingdom. Will you be able to defeat them?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/f7fcfcbb5e5faa81de5f1201637baa3e81ec6298.png[/img]
[h3]Raid Shrine[/h3]
Once you have conquered Vanaheim, a new kind of shrine will appear! This Shrine will teleport a horde of enemies from another realm, giving you the opportunity to defeat, let’s see… the Skavenger King on Jotunheim for example???
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c2ef1caca2015a94d371eb95f00529db16b03a91.png[/img]
[h2]Game Modes[/h2]
Three exciting news:
First of all, we know many of you are waiting for the Endless Mode release. We are making many improvements so hopefully it will be ready in a few weeks. We will open a Beta branch for those that wish to test it before anyone else. More details soon.

Secondly, we are currently developing a new game mode, the Challenge Mode, where you’ll find a daily challenge. It will be available on the Beta branch too.

That being said, this Challenge Mode will allow us to introduce some new handicaps to the Adventure mode such as being able to play runs deactivating Yggdrasil, not visiting Gnöki’s realm, etc. in case you want to customize your runs and make them more challenging.

[h2]Nordic Ashes Original Soundtrack[/h2]
We have teamed up with [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RubenMeliaComposer]Rubén Melià[/url] to create our own soundtrack!

The first track available is Nordic Ashes Main Theme. It is the music that plays on the main menu. We really hope you love it as much as we do, and we invite you to listen to the full track!

Rubén is already working on the Midgard track. We will release new music in future updates.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
We are adding new credits on the settings panel to thank the wonderful content creators that have supported us, thank you thank you! 

[h3]New relic [/h3]
We also wanted to release this new legendary relic, the Beam Pyramid, a true enemy destroyer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c8ef2b148b9af9a68ecf311729d5676021d74eb6.png[/img]
[h2]Upcoming Realms[/h2]

A few months ago, we released trading cards, emojis and backgrounds for Nordic Ashes, so this is just a friendly reminder that you already have them available to collect!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/4eb64474bdfaa38b1f199f2bbee3ffa2d8714a95.png[/img]

[list]

It was time for Svartalfheim Ragnarok to arrive, so here it is! Challenge yourself with stronger enemies and bosses and conquer the dwarves’ realm!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/6563591a5e3dd3ff76506dcce9f92474df32b5f1.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
We have implemented simple but effective tutorials so some concepts like how Ascensions work are crystal clear. We hope these are useful for new players.

[h2]Community Suggestions[/h2]
We’ve been reading all of your comments. Here are many of the ideas you’ve suggested, whether they are QoL, balancing related or just minor improvements we hope we did a good job implementing them. There are still a few to develop, and they will be added in future updates.
[list]
[*] Olga’s Blessing third piece was hard to find as it was Epic tier. It is now a Rare item, so you should find all the pieces faster.
[*] Chest, potion, artifact and Ascension Crystal info is now shown in the Glossary.
[*] Shuffling Helga’s Tarot Deck will now be influenced by Cooldown.
[*] Sacrifice Shrine has been reworked. Enemy souls will enter the shrine if you defeat them by YOU being INSIDE of the circled area. So, it won’t matter if enemies are inside or outside the area. The only condition is that YOU are inside.
[*] The wave bar won’t disappear anymore during mid-boss fights.
[*] Thyra’s ulti is now smarter. It will now move and search for the closest enemies.
[*] Now you will be able to hide requirements in the achievements, leaf and glossary panels with the same keys/buttons.
[*] Gnöki will finally smile at you when you reach level 5 of Happiness.
[*] Weapons are now displayed from more to less DMG dealt in the end panel.
[*] The “+” next to a relic on the end panel will now mean the number of resets instead the number of ascensions, as you will also see the icon of an Ascension Crystal next to the name of the relic.
[*] Talkor’s THE coin ascension description has been updated.
[*] The Yggdrasil upgrade “99+” description has been updated.
[*] The number of times you can revive is now better displayed, next to the character’s heart containers.
[*] Crystal Soul relic has been reworked. It will double the number of red hearts and turn them into blue ones and will also exceed the limit of 14 hearts if that’s the case.
[*] Many of you were asking that after unlocking higher difficulty levels, to be able to play them right after a new realm is released. So now, if you have already conquered Expert in other realms, you will be able to play Expert on new realms without having to play Normal and then Hard. The same happens with Ragnarok levels. However, in order to play Ragnarok, you must have conquered Expert on that realm.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Axeldör’s hammer wasn’t working properly.
[*] Amaranth’s xp earning was bugged, so the xp you earned with Ivy was insanely high. It has now been fixed to its normal amount. It also was bugged in the opposite way, not gathering all the xp it should in some cases. 
[*] Electric Rune was only firing 1 projectile.
[*] Axeldör’s axe was only firing 1 lightning bolt.
[*] Thyra’s arrows won’t feel “drunken” anymore when playing at high FPS.
[/list]

We have also been working on improving performance.

That’s all for today’s update. We were planning to release the next realm’s beta next week, but we will need 1 more week to do so. So expect Vanaheim Beta in two weeks from now!
Cheers!

notes.title: Community suggestions and feedback
notes.notes:
Hello! 

First of all, thanks again for your feedback about the new features and changes we’ve made to Nordic Ashes. The game is still on Early Access, and we really appreciate all your comments, positive or negative, so we can make the game better and better.


Since we launched [b]Endless Mode[/b], we’ve been debating if it was a good idea or not to release it so early. There have been [b]major performance issues[/b] and runs went from 60FPS to 2, and that led to a [b]bad game experience[/b]. We tried to solve it with performance fixes, but we also [b]nerfed[/b] relics and features for the sake of Endless Mode.

[b]And that is not the path we want to follow. Sacrificing fun relics in exchange for a few more FPS was not a good deal.[/b]

That being said, we’re gonna put [b]Endles Mode on hold[/b] at least for now, until it is well optimized and better designed to make it more unique.

In return, we’re[b] bringing back[/b] the functionality that nerfed relics deserve, as our main goal is to provide a fun, fresh and replayable game. That is Nordic Ashes true core! They are the following:
[list]
[*] R.E.S.E.T. can be used once again twice on each weapon, to a new max. of 5 times.
[*] Discount Coupon will work as it used to. It will always grant a discount in every relic.
[*] Relic stat limit has been removed.
[*] Axeldör’s Fury limit has been removed.
[*] Talkor’s Greed scales endlessly again, 1% per gold.
[*] Talkor’s Orbs scale endlessly, 0.25% per gold.
[*] Thyra and Hafgrim are easier to unlock.
[/list]

Another well known suggestion is the [b]grinding feeling[/b] the game can give:
[list]
[*] The seed-leaf exchange price has been lowered.
[*] The amount of leaves for each Yggdrasil tier has been lowered.
[/list]


We felt that the game had lost some of its fun by capping so many things, and the only reason behind it was to try to improve Endless performance. We do not want that for the sake of a game mode, everything has to be modified. And well, the core of this genre is to have fun and get the most broken builds!

[b]Aaaand tomorrow we will release the new character![/b]

It is a pleasure to be able to develop this game with all of you ːNA_Gnokiː
