notes.title: Update v0.9.3
notes.notes:
Hello!
Hope you’re having a nice week. These are the new updates for today:

[h2]Yggdrasil has grown![/h2]
The Yggdrasil tree has expanded its branches introducing new combat upgrades that will allow you to better customize your survivors.

You will now be able to upgrade your [b]movement speed[/b], [b]status effect chance[/b], [b]crit chance[/b] and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c5df66bf12b5c5aba4438ccea1fff5bb7986973a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We have also unlocked [b]25 new leaves[/b] that can be obtained with seeds.
[/list]
[h2]New Relics![/h2]
Today we introduce 9 new passive relics! We will be adding more and more in future updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/1cae6d3d7ca03f3e3858b56989103ed817443191.png[/img]

[h2]Endless[/h2]
We are continuously working on game performance, and we will keep doing it this way until Endless mode feels all right. We really want to thank you for your endless feedback too 😉 
With this update you will notice that the game runs better and smoother. We know that there can still be lag issues when having many relics and we are working to fix that too.

Apart from this, we have reduced boss and elite monster’s health. We want them to be fun and not that tanky. We have also added a new feature to Endless enemies, they will now be faster and faster on each cycle to makes it more challenging.

Due to these changes, we will reset the Endless rankings.

[h2]Gnöki’s shop[/h2]
Gnöki hired a few builders and then added some home decor to his shop. He has a very particular style, and will make you like it too, I mean, *hope* you like it too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/d6bae6013123afcf3b8dd5d21cb33ce2607b43dc.png[/img]

[h3]Changes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have reworked the Poison Bomb Growth Ascension to the new Cluster Explosion Ascension. The previous ascension created major performance issues in the game.
[*] Optimized the performance of the Poison Bomb.
[*] Optimized the performance of Axeldor's Brann.
[*] Optimized the performance of Astrid's Orb.
[*] You can now see the amount of times you have left to revive when collecting the Valknut Goblet.
[*] G.L.I.T.C.H. visual appearance has been changed.
[*] The Glitch Explosion Ascension did not scale with the Relic area.
[*] The damage awarded by the Last Breath Relic has been increased to a 100%.
[*] R.E.S.E.T. is now only applied once per ascended weapon up to a maximum of 3 weapons. 
[*] Discount Coupon’s discount is only applied to the first product sold in each pillar.
[*] You can now skip the animation when picking up a chest.
[*] The stats of Experience Collection Range and Status Effects Duration Increase are now shown as percentages.
[*] Talkor's Orbs now apply both stats. We have changed the value and stats to make this ability more even.
[*] We know many people felt Jotunheim 1st boss, Bothild was too fast. We hope that with the new Yggdrasil Mov. Speed box things improve.
[*] Jotunheim’s 2nd boss, Snaer, was too fast with his skill casting. We have updated it, giving the player more time to react.
[*] Weapons bought from a survivor at Gnöki’s shop will only be able to be ascended once, so choose carefully which ascension you prefer!
[/list]

[h3]Next week’s update![/h3]
In one week, we will all be able to play with the new character. Here’s a sneak peek!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/310e74fc3be4cf99bebd07b141321e70c20218c9.png[/img]

notes.title: New Realm Jotunheim + New Game Mode Endless
notes.notes:
Today we bring you a really cool (no pun intended, maybe yes) update with the release of a new Realm and a new Game Mode!

[h2]Jotunheim Realm![/h2]
Welcome to the frozen depths of Jotunheim, home to giants and monstrous (for some people adorable) creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bc8d41d058bc8fa471ddc258dee1039ea73a8334.png[/img]
This new Realm comes with a new mechanic, [b]Curses[/b], effects that will last the entire run. Specifically, Jotunheim comes with the Frost Curse that will reduce your stat speed over time. But don't worry, warm yourself up around a bonfire to reduce the freezing and you will be good to go.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/72000767f75f5b3bdc91a908a39f06db4d188c80.png[/img]
You may find a more detailed info about the Freezing Curse in the pause panel.

[h2]Endless Mode![/h2]
Once you have completed any Realm on Expert mode, you will be able to access Endless Mode. A never ending run where you can test your best build and see how far you can go.
Each time you complete a cycle the enemies will get stronger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/49546db8503b8617308c0860544c5dd6fda91b52.png[/img]

[h2]New Relics![/h2]
Wanna wield Orglo’s staff? Or maybe wear Halvard’s crown to summon burning rocks that fall from the sky?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/81a4cf672b639f1f67acf544cef920058b6053fc.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused bosses to stop moving.
[*] Time begun to run before starting a game.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI information about how much damage mobs/boss inflict is better displayed. This UI position is adjusted when the Wave bar is hidden.
[*] Ragnarok final bosses and some enemies HP has been increased.
[*] In Endless Mode you will have the option to Surrender at any time in the pause panel.
[*] Game performance has been improved. Players who were experiencing low fps should now see an improvement. We are still working on performance to provide the best experience possible.
[*] Now setting the effect visibility to minimum value will make projectiles and their related effects to be fully transparent.
[*] Leaderboards will reset with this update.
[/list]

We would like to thank all the people who have helped us during the Beta. Thank you very much for supporting us!!

Ready for Jotunheim Beta? Grab your favorite scarf and maybe a beanie or two, cause this update will be a freezing experience!
You may find all the info about how to join the beta here: [b]PLEASE READ ALL THE INFO [/b]

Remember you don’t have to join the beta if you prefer to wait till next week and play the finished content 😉

[h2]Beta New Content![/h2]
[list]
[*] Jotunheim Realm
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Freezing curse
[*] Rage mode is implemented again. You’ll be able to try it on Expert and Ragnarok Modes 
[/list]
[h3]Some fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy immunities shown in the glossary.
[*] Immunity Destroyer is now legendary.
[*] Improved the performance of enemy attacks that could cause lag.
[/list]
[h2]How to access the Beta?[/h2]
[b]REMEMBER[/b]: To play the beta, you will need to have purchased Nordic Ashes previously.
[olist]
[*] Open the Steam application.
[*] Go to the Steam library and select Nordic Ashes. 
[*] Right click on it and select Properties.
[*] A panel will open, select the Beta option.
[*] Enter the following code: [b]NordicAshesBeta[/b]
[*] Click the button to verify that it is correct.
[*] If everything is OK, you will have the Beta option in the drop-down menu. Select it and the game will be updated.
[/olist]
[h3]Beta Information[/h3]
Thank you very much for helping us improve the game. You are an amazing community 😄
First of all, we’d like to share the following disclaimer (don’t forget to read #9)

[olist]
[*] Keep in mind that this is a Beta and therefore it may contain bugs and balancing issues.
[*] The purpose of the Beta is that you have access to an early version of the game, so you can help us to fix bugs, balance the game and give suggestions.
[*] The Betas last for a certain period of time. We will release them as new updates are released. This particular one will be open for 1 week.
[*] There is a specific discussion for beta feedback in Steam.
[*] The Beta progress will be saved in your actual account.
[*] You can unlock the Steam achievements already published, but the new ones that will be released will not be available. However, once the Beta version is released, you will receive all achievements you have already earned.
[*] You may upload or stream Beta content if you wish. However, please add a disclaimer to your videos/streams to announce that it is the Beta you are playing, not the public version of the game.
[*] IMPORTANT: To avoid any loss of your progress please follow the next steps:
         a.    Create a backup of your saving files just in case. There should be no issues but just to be safe please do. You may find them here: 
                 i.    windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
                 ii.    macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/com.NoxfallStudios.NordicAshes/Backup
                 iii.    linux: ~/.config/unity3d/Noxfall Studios/Nordic Ashes/Backup
         b.    After playing the Beta, if you wish to return to the main version of the game and deactivate the Beta, please notice that your Beta progress will be lost.
[/olist]

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]
It is possible that you find bugs or content that has yet to be implemented, such as sounds. We thank you for notifying us of any bug or issue through our discord or steam discussions, in the specific Beta section. This way we can access all the information and fix any issues. Thank you so much!

notes.title: Update 0.8.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we bring you a patch that balances the game and fixes a few bugs. It also introduces new changes on Shrines and Yggdrasil.

[h2]Shrines [/h2]
We have modified how shrines are displayed in runs. Previously, all the Shrines appeared from the beginning. Now, at the start of the game you will have 4 Common Shrines available that can give you Common or Rare relics. After defeating the first boss and returning from Gnöki’s Realm, 2 new Rare Shrines will appear, which will give you Rare or Epic relics. Finally, after defeating the second boss and returning from Gnöki, a new Epic Shrine will appear, which will grant you an Epic relic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/da2fc9e2fbe62eae371274f611232dc9e434e88f.png[/img]
The rarity of the Shrines will affect the requirements of each one of them.

With this change you will always have something to do when you return from Gnöki.

[h2]Yggdrasil[/h2]
The Shrine update affects Yggdrasil too. Some power-ups have been modified and some new ones have been added. Above all, the last upgrade in the Buildings branch has been changed, and we are really looking forward for you to try it. With this upgrade, after you complete a Shrine, there will be a 25% chance that the Shrine will activate again, so you can get another reward. PS: it also affects the Ascension Shrine ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/280389a127691968d72a38c284029da0e4875f1d.png[/img]

The last power-up of the Healing branch has also received an upgrade. It can now be upgraded up to level 3, giving one extra resurrection per level.

And… Many of you have been asking for this feature: You’ll be able to [b]save up to 5 different Yggdrasil builds[/b]! We hope this helps you a ton!

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[h3]Artifacts[/h3]
Regarding artifacts, there still be more and more of them and the pool will get bigger and bigger, making it more difficult to get the ones you want. Therefore, we have made the following changes:
[list]
[*] When you reroll in Gnöki's Store you will always get a different potion, artifact, rune or chest.
[*] Gnöki's Store will now provide an extra artifact from Happiness level 3 onwards.
[*] Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Poison artifact cards still do not make the impact we’d like to. For now, we have raised their effect probability to 75% (previously 50%). With the next Realm release there will be new elemental synergies and these cards will have a higher power.
[*] The fireball artifact now releases several bursts of fire and more projectiles.
[/list]

[h3]Survivors[/h3]
Some survivors benefit from certain relics and others are of no use to them. We have made certain relics more likely to appear depending on the survivor you are playing. eg: Thyra will have more relics related to poison, Hafgrim with the 3 elements, Talkôr with gold...
This does not mean that the other relics will not appear, but they have less probability to do so.
Talkôr has undergone some improvements:
[list]
[*] Talkôr has two new relics in his constellation, which we know you're surely like.
[*] His ultimate can now also give you gold or artifacts when used.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/664e95d0dd676eb7258d65f7b0401d8728187d95.png[/img]

[h3]Relics[/h3]
As expected, certain weapons were too OP while others were not reaching the expected results:
[b]Axeldör[/b]:[list]
[*] Stormbringer: Axe damage upgrades have been reduced.
[*] Iron Hammer: the cooldown has been reduced and the attack speed has been increased.[/list][b]Thyra[/b]:[list]
[*] Poison Bomb: number of projectiles has been increased.
[*] Poison Bomb's Area Expansion Ascension speed has been increased.
[*] Focus effect is clearer. It now affects the character.[/list][b]Hafgrim[/b]:[list]
[*] Thunder Codex: cooldown has been reduced.[/list][b]Helga[/b]:[list]
[*] Book of Stars: cooldown has been reduced and attack speed has been increased.
[*] Tarot deck: reduced the cooldown and the time it takes for each card to appear.[/list]

[h2]Fixes and improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Artifacts were not working properly. Some of them didn't let you use them and sometimes another one appeared.

notes.title: Update 0.8.2
notes.notes:
It’s already been two months since we launched Nordic Ashes Early Access! I mean, we feel like we’ve know you for at least a year now! In the previous update we released Svartalfheim and a new game mode, Ragnarok.
In today’s update we bring you a new survivor, [b]Talkôr[/b]! Wait whaaaat! Those of you who already conquered Svartalfheim will know him. And now, you will have the chance to play as him and crush some enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/11f54c17b2fd7a0bfbf71c5b480adb245674cbf4.png[/img]
[h2]Talkôr[/h2]
Unlike the other Survivors, [b]his power lies in gold[/b]. He has no heart containers but gold as his source of life. Every time he takes damage, he will lose gold (aka Health Points) and every time he spends money he will lose HP too. Conversely, if he earns gold, he will earn HP. Also, keep in mind life potions or HP Relics have no effect on him!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/3196d3a5b8f6aa128767d54a735cdeab79677ef5.png[/img]
[h3]New Ancestral Relics![/h3]
These Relics are related to gold, boosting Talkôr's abilities. Choose well what you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/e6eb7d03856d4aa20ec61321b89afff22cd7e04a.png[/img]

[h3]Special Weapon![/h3]
The weapon Talkôr starts with is a bit special, it only has 1 level. However, it will be boosted according to the amount of gold you have.

Talkôr is not a Nordic Ashes original character but has been with us since the beginning of our journey as developers, being the main character of our first game back in 2016. And we are extremely excited for him to join our team of survivors.

We hope you enjoy playing as Talkôr!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/cc861ce4a9b5799737a3d6d016e01d7b821fa0f8.png[/img]

[h3]Some fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character, Realm and Game mode selected are now saved each time you open the game.
[*] Some of you had issues uploading your time to the leaderboard, this should be fixed by now. 
[*] Minor performance improvements. We’re still working on performance issues, we´ll do our best to make it run as smooth as possible.
[/list]

[h2]Sneak peek[/h2]
And now, as a sneak peek for the next character (because we know all you want are leaves) we will tell you this: We hope you like plants. Nature can be a mighty force.

notes.title: New Realm Svartalfheim + New Game Mode Ragnarok
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all for the great support and trust we've received so far! And welcome everyone that joined this adventure! We are creating an incredible community. And of course, many thanks to all the people who participated in the beta <3

To celebrate the release of this major update Nordic Ashes will get a [b]10% discount[/b]!
Now grab yourself your favorite beverage and let's jump into the longest patch notes we've ever written:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/715fc513f031c00115de0fed5bd5b9b8eb66442f.png[/img]
[h2]Svartalfheim Realm[/h2]
Each Realm is becoming a bit more difficult than the previous one, thanks to the new mechanics they bring. We do not want to spoil you everything, so we'll let you explore Svartalfheim at your own pace. 
This Realm comes with a new merchant, Talkor, that just settled in Gnöki’s Realm. He will know what to do with all the gold you have gathered before the final boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/94746da30368810bc001803956488adb367db8d1.png[/img]

[h2]Ragnarok + Leaderboard![/h2]
New Ragnarok game mode! If you are open to a greater challenge, this game mode is for you. Face classic elites and bosses with a twist, they now wield powerful abilities! 
The leaderboard is only available on Ragnarok difficulties and information will only be displayed if you successfully complete a run. [b]Plus, each Survivor has their own leaderboard![/b].

For now, this game mode will only be available on Midgard. We want to see first impressions and how the game mode evolves before opening it to other realms. Check enemy power descriptions in the Pause Panel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/28d207307691d5ffe008310db8254f2a322cb900.png[/img]
[h2]New content[/h2]
[h3]Yggdrasil[/h3]
This update also comes with the 5th Yggdrasil Tier! You will be able to unlock it when you reach 100 leaves. Reach new levels of power with these upgrades to challenge the new Ragnarok game mode.
The leaf limit that can be achieved with seeds has been increased by 50.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/cc5d5507fd15a72967c71af765b73a40de5b244d.png[/img]

[h3]Stats Reroll[/h3]
New stat reroll enhancement. It will reduce bad luck so you don’t get Duration four times in a row lol (not only Duration, just kidding, it will apply to all stats).

Also, levels 6 and 8 of all weapons have been upgraded being level 6 a Rare - Rare upgrade and level 8 Rare - Epic.

[h3]Health & Potions[/h3]
We have limited the number of hearts that can be obtained to 14. You will have ways to break that limit in the future 😉
The good news is that potions have become smarter. If you have Overhealing activated, you will now be able to take potions until you reach the maximum blue hearts. Also green hearts will have priority over blue hearts. So, if you have the maximum hearts and you pick up a green potion, a blue heart will be swapped into a green one. The same goes for red hearts, which will have priority over any other heart.

[b]Green hearts rework[/b]: These hearts will now release xp orbs when broken.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/528c6e1a822870131c36fe7d4d41ce54086d7460.png[/img]
[h3]Fire and Poison[/h3]
The way Burned and Poisoned status effects work has been modified. 
[b]Burned[/b]: Deals damage every half second equal to your burn damage + 5, for 3 seconds.
[b]Poisoned[/b]: Deals damage equal to the poison damage + 3, which increases exponentially every second, for 3 seconds.

In addition, new Relics have been added to create synergies with these status effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/be08fb19f77f16658cb1f6056db155b47c4ac5ad.png[/img]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new kinds of shrines have been added! The Time Shrine and the Level Shrine. New ways to get Relics!
[*] Talkôr will sell you a new kind of item: runes! 
[*] Gnöki's store products now have different rarities and prices. 
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Helga was a bit too strong, and possibly she still is. We wanted to balance her ultimate by reducing the value of the stats and limiting the number of stats she can accumulate per level. However, still really broken.
[*] Axeldör, Thyra and Hafgrim's Ultimate stat boost now applies to every Relic, including their Ultimate.
[*] The Minimap has become essential for many players, so we decided to make it available from the beginning. You will be able to upgrade it in Yggdrasil.
[*] Bosses and elites are now displayed in the minimap.
[*] Shrines no longer provide chests.
[*] Status effects can be applied to bosses at last. Note that certain bosses are immune to certain status effects. For example, The Ruined Tyrant is immune to poison. Still, final bosses have no immunities (at least for now).
[*] Burn Damage and Poison Damage passives have been added to M.I.S.S.S.I.N.G.’s constellation.
[*] The performance of the XP ring has been optimized. #NoMoreLag
[*] The Snowflake Relic had almost no impact, so we have improved it to make its power more rewarding.
[*] Flint now also increases your burn damage.
[*] Each new Realm has a higher seed drop.
[*] The length of Midgard Normal (-40%) and Hard (-20%) runs has been reduced. That way it will be more accessible for new players.
[*] To improve performance, a new feature has been added. XP orbs that are close to each other will merge together, providing always the total xp they should give. This way, we drastically reduce the number of xp orbs on screen and improve the game performance.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Ruined Tyrant dash has been fixed to make it easier to see.
[*] Improved how the Relics you have while playing are displayed. You may disable how they are displayed in the settings panel.
[*] Fixed a bug that appeared when you won and died at the same time.
[*] The wave timeline now shows all the elite spawns correctly.
[*] M.I.S.S.I.N.G.'s Relics are no longer duplicated in the Constellation and in the store.
[*] Gnöki's achievements did not appear as completed in some cases.
[/list]
[h2]When new character?[/h2]
New character! Next week a new survivor will be released, a Svartalfheim special 😉
A challenging new Survivor to enjoy!

[h2]Community[/h2]
[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]
Trading cards, emojis, badges and wallpapers are currently under Steam review, that means they will be available very soon!
[h3]Acknowledgments[/h3]
Many thanks to everyone helping us to improve the game with ideas, suggestions, bug fixes and translations.

Special thanks to:[list]

We're working on the game credits too, we will add you as soon as they're ready!

notes.title: Svartalfheim News!
notes.notes:
Today we bring you some hot news about the next [b]major update[/b]! Here's what's coming on [b]February 9th[/b]!
We won’t reveal all of the content as we’d like to keep some as a surprise :D

[h2]Svartalfheim[/h2]
This update introduces the third Realm, Svartalfheim! New and powerful minions, Elites and Bosses await you here. In this realm you will find new Relics, Yggdrasil Leaves, a new Survivor and a new Merchant in Gnöki’s Realm! At last, all the gold you earned during the last wave will be useful! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/94746da30368810bc001803956488adb367db8d1.png[/img]

[h2]Expert+[/h2]
For some of you, Expert mode was too easy to conquer. 
Don’t worry those who feel Hard is hard enough, for me too (Naya, the game artist). 
We know your deep desire to reach your limits and unleash the power of your builds. With this new game mode, you will compete in a Ranking with other players. Will you be able to reach the highest tier?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/f73d719061ebf28f2b9a09a1685e098fd0ffd7cd.png[/img]

[h2]Fire and Poison[/h2]
We’ve made a few changes about how these two status effects work. And yes, they will now affect bosses ;)

[h2]Shrines, Artifacts and Relics[/h2]
This expansion comes with new shrines that will allow you to get even more Relics. Also, new Artifacts to make you more powerful in case you need them. And let's not forget about brand new Relics + their Ascensions to complete your build.

[h2]Beta[/h2]
We want to polish this update as best as possible, so we will grant a beta access to those players who wish to try the game before its release.  That way we will be able to fix the upcoming issues. 
Anyone willing to participate will be able to join through a link we will provide via our [url=https://discord.gg/RhdgScwtm9]Discord[/url] channel. Thanks so much in advance! The beta will open 1 week before the major release, that is, [b]February 2nd[/b] aka next week!

Thanks again for all your suggestions, even though we don’t answer all your requests, be sure that we read them all and take them into account.
Until next time!

notes.title: Update v0.7.5
notes.notes:
It’s been a whole month since the Early Access launch! You guys have been amazing, thanks for your support and feedback. Also, a warm welcome to all the new vikings that have just joined this wonderful community!

In this update we want bring some important QoL improvements, better performance, survivors balancing, a few bug fixes and… new Ascensions!

[h2]Survivors[/h2]
[b]Axeldör, Thyra and Hafgrim's Ultimate Abilities have been upgraded[/b]. Each time you activate their definite ability, they will also receive a stat boost that will last as long as their ulti.
For example, Axeldör's  Infinity Whirlwind will now increase his Relic damage by 25/50/100% and his Relic area by 50/100/150%. These boosts will only be applied to the character’s Relics, not to the Ultimate’s stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/cf9966cd1d399c8af90f878727bbbf7805389d0f.png[/img]

[b]Hafgrim's Fjölkyngi Staff AI has been improved[/b], being now able to target the same enemy with different projectiles.
In addition, one of his constellation restrictions has been removed. That way, you’ll be able to go to both left and right passive branches.

[b]Thyra also got a rework.[/b] Her passives were limited to Bows, Daggers and Bombs, now they are not, making her more flexible and rewarding to create powerful builds. This improvement will also boost the Secret Character’s builds.

[h2]Ascensions[/h2]
Weapons you bought from Gnöki were always a nice addition, but maybe not strong enough, they lacked Ascensions... So, we chatted with the Norse Gods and they finally agreed to add Ascensions to these weapons too!! Can’t wait for you to use Ascension crystals and try them out!
Sadly, winter Relics did not get an Ascension. It’s a secret, but someone told us they will next time they pop up for future winter seasons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/8a54952c12c83a05e0a0296ed2bf2a184f7fc908.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[h3]Settings[/h3]
We have improved and added new features to the Settings panel. You may customize it as you wish:
[list]
[*] Choose enemy attacks color.
[*] New option to see enemy attacks on the top layer.
[*] Visual effects alpha option.
[*] Camera shake amount.
[*] Move your character using the mouse (this option disables moving with the keyboard).
[*] FPS rate.
[/list]
[h3]Glossary[/h3]
Many of you have been asking for this upgrade! Each time you approach a Relic, you’ll be able to see its description. This way you can know what each Relic does before you grab it. 
An option has been added to the settings panel to remove this aid in case you don’t need it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/d5b810efeb599ebede3bea5187d0aa3a6e645373.png[/img]

[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] Obelisk cooldown now starts right after you pick up its buff.
[*] Active Relics such as the Dancing Spear can now appear in Altars.
[*] When collected, every Active Relic will start at Level 5. (In future Yggdrasil updates, you’ll able to increase this level).
[*] Once you have defeated a boss for the first time, it will drop some seeds. The amount of seeds you earn will depend on the amount time you take to defeat it.
[*] The number of leaves that can be obtained to upgrade Yggdrasil has been increased by 10.
[*] Restart button has been added to de Pause menu.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overheal was not working properly.
[*] XP multiplier stat was not being applied when collecting experience.
[*] Tarot Deck now hits elites.
[*] Åse's feathers were sometimes not damaging enemies.
[*] Fixed a problem with data saving that caused a loss of progress on very rare occasions.
[*] Eir's Freezing Path Ascension stopped working when you went to Gnöki’s Realm.
[*] RNG Tonic didn’t show which stat was boosted in some cases. 
[/list]

[h2]Future update![/h2]
Some of you are starting to accumulate too many seeds and they will finally come in handy in this future update! The only thing we can say is that Expert+ mode is nearer and nearer. In this new mode, you’ll be able to decide how strong enemies are and see how far you can go.


If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, don't hesitate to contact us:

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.notes:
Time’s up! Today we’re finally launching Nordic Ashes in Early Access and you will all be able to enjoy this Enemy Hell Survivor adventure!

[h3]What to expect from Midgard and the 9 Realms[/h3]
[list]
[*] You will be able to face powerful enemies in the 9 Realms of Yggdrasil.
[*] Collect Relics that will make you as powerful as the Asgard gods themselves.
[*] Ascend your Ancestral Relics so that no minion will stop you. 
[*] Find fellow survivors and together, face what remains after Ragnarök.
[*] Obtain Yggdrasil leaves to get permanent upgrades.
[*] Improve your affection level with Gnöki to get amazing rewards.
[*] Create your own build for each character and each run choosing your path in their Constellation Ability Trees.
[*] Use each survivor’s Ultimate ability to annihilate your enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Too easy?[/h3]
Don't worry, as you complete a Realm on one difficulty, the next will be unlocked, with new challenges to meet and rewards to earn.

[h3]Do you love completing achievements?[/h3]
More than 60 achievements to accomplish, a number that will increase as we release more content.

[h3]How much variety is there?[/h3]
There are more than 70 Relics in the game, plus different artifacts, potions, survivors, realms, altars, Gnöki’s realm, Yggdrasil meta progression... and this is only the first Early Access release of many updates to come.

[h3]What makes us different from other survivor-like games?[/h3]
[list]
[*] This game is much more challenging. Why? The HP system is based in heart containers as in Binding of Isaac, so beware of being touched by monsters, enemies are much more complex, bosses have their own behavior with unique attacks that make them really fun as well as challenging.
[*] Characters won’t start with a weapon and that would be it. Each one has their own constellation with various weapons, powers and upgrades that will allow you to make creative builds. Also, this makes each character feel unique.
[*] When you level up you will receive level points. Each weapon can be upgraded with those points. The cool thing is that each upgrade will have semi-random stats. If you don't like the stats you got, you can reroll and see if you have better luck.
[*] Find shrines around the realms that will reward you with useful Relics or special upgrade chests.
[*] Each Ancestral Relic can be Ascended up to 2 times, giving each Ascension a unique upgrade.
[/list]
[h3]So that's it?[/h3]
Of course not. There are always secrets, such as <missing>... and many updates to come in the following weeks and months.

Remember that during the Early Access you will have the possibility of obtaining the Knights of The Dark Skins in the game. After that, they will become Legacy skins and nobody else will be able to get them anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/db0ec6bd923bff9b9acc0fdc0abc9e177ce67a5d.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy Nordic Ashes as much as we do. If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, don't hesitate to contact us:

notes.title: Playtest Open
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

Thank you all so much for your patience and support. We are so happy to announce that Nordic Ashes Playtest opens today!

[h3]🔸What is a Playtest?[/h3]
The main goal of Playtest is to provide the developers a way to test the game, from the best testers - PLAYERS! Thanks to this feature, developers can create a separate application containing a part of the game so players can test it. Most importantly, these players have unique access to the game!

[h3]🔸Extremely important:[/h3]
- This is not the full version of the game. Keep in mind that the content and mechanics in the Playtest may differ from the release version of Nordic Ashes.
- Feel free to stream or record your gameplay. Just make sure your subscribers are aware that this is a Playtest.

[h3]🔸How do I get access?[/h3]
- On the game page, click "Request Access" → wait → Steam will send you an email that Playtest access has been granted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/5099a3916846da68372f672651f0ed095ef180e3.jpg[/img]

[h3]🔸How long will it last?[/h3]
The playtest will last for 1 week, ending on November 30th at 23:59. That day, access to all players will be closed. However, that day we will also announce the OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE and the starting price, along with some other surprises!

[h3]🔸FEEDBACK[/h3]
Please remember the most important thing for us is your feedback. If you find any bugs or language mistakes, please let us know. From the very beginning, we’ve listened to our community's ideas and suggestions, it is extremely important to us, to read your feedback.

You can leave your feedback on a special [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2068280/discussions/]Steam discussion[/url] - or on our [url=https://discord.gg/RhdgScwtm9]Discord[/url] server. An example of such feedback:
1.	Description of the problem
2.	PC Specifications
3.	Screenshots 

[i]As always, our dear warriors, let the wind of the north mountains give you strength to fight doom. Remember, you are true Survivors of Ragnarök.[/i]

[list]
[*] Some of you were having trouble with RNG when no potions or gold dropped. So now, an internal cooldown has been created in case you had no luck. That way, after the cooldown is over, enemies will drop a potion and gold will be found in crates, 100% guaranteed.

[*] 4 new Languages added! French, Italian, Polish and Ukrainian. We want the game to be accessible everywhere. 
[/list]

As always, we are working as hard and fast as we can to give you the best game possible. We are delighted to know that you are supporting us since the beginning. A big thanks!

From this point our team will be fully focused on the Early Access. Follow our Social Media and Discord to learn more about the game and how the development is progressing!

notes.title: Visual Update! v0.5.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Visuals Update![/h1]

In this update we focused on [b]enhancing the visuals[/b] of the game. Feedback from damaged enemies and Relic magic effects were not vibrant enough. So, we have improved lighting and shaders in many ways to make the user experience more dynamic and fun.

[h2]Thyra[/h2]
Also, [b]Thyra’s Uncanny Bow[/b] has been remade. We knew it worked fine but the visuals and feeling was not at the level we wanted. Now you have super cool looking arrows that resonate best with Thyra and the colors of the Uncanny Bow.

[h2]Passive Relics[/h2]
In addition, now the [b]Survivor Constellation[/b] shows the Passive Relics you have recollected in your run. Yeeey!

[h2]Fixed Issues[/h2]
To end, we have fixed some issues:
[list]
[*] Halvard The Destroyer’s Meteor Strike sound effect wasn’t affected by the settings volume.
[*] Sometimes when you went to Gnöki’s dimension a black screen persisted.
[*] UI wasn’t adjusting correctly in 4:3 screens.
[*] Now when you pause the game the timer stops counting.
[*] Máni’s Bow arrows color have also been changed.
[*] Survivors movement has been improved. Now it should be more responsive.
[/list]
[h2]Hafgrim's Enlightment[/h2]
Last but not least, [b]Hafgrim[/b] has been reading ancient magic books while Thyra and Axeldör where destroying all the enemy hordes. This has enlighted him and granted him [b]another blue heart container[/b] as a reward for his hard work. Also, his skill with the [b]Fjölkyngi Staff has improved[/b] and now some of his projectiles target the nearest enemy.
We hope his work pays off and you give it a try :)

notes.title: NORDIC ASHES - Major Update - v0.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Nordic Ashes - Major Update[/h1]

[previewyoutube=WKrnBC2IeV0;full][/previewyoutube]
With this update we wanted to distance our game from the rest of Survivor-themed games. We’ve decided to focus on the essence of the [b]Roguelike genre[/b], inspired by top games like The Binding of Isaac and Rogue Legacy among others, but not forgetting that fun part of Survivor games: the pressure of waves and the satisfaction of defeating many enemies at once, like in Vampire Survivors or 20 Seconds till Dawn.

As you all know, at first, we wanted to develop a more Roguelite game, with buffs between runs that made you more powerful each time. However, the Roguelike allows us to make a much deeper gameplay with more personality. It's a concept that excites us as game developers and we hope you like the result as much as we do.

The Roguelike has taken a great weight in our game and you will notice it when you play it. We really want to know what you think and your first impressions on all these new changes!

[h2]MIDGARD[/h2]
The realm of Midgard has been redesigned bringing it to life. You will find beautiful ruins and vegetation scattered around the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/6770b679ccd8439416a3d91433a890f4ba79799a.png[/img]

[h2]Heart containers [/h2]
One of the most important changes that you will notice as soon as you start playing this new adventure is the vitality system. [b]Each heart is now divided into 2 pieces[/b], so each hit will only reduce half a heart container. This will allow you to last much longer. This change allows us to have better control the damage inflicted, although we warn you, beware of the bosses…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/528c6e1a822870131c36fe7d4d41ce54086d7460.png[/img]
In addition to the Red Hearts, Blue Hearts, or Soul Hearts, have appeared. Unlike the red ones, once you lose them, you won't get them back unless you find specific items.

You will notice this change with Hafgrim in particular, since he now has just one red and one blue heart container, making it more difficult (but also more challenging) for him to survive. However, Axeldör and Thyra maintain the same number of life containers as before.

[h2]Secrets![/h2]
We want this Universe to be full of relics that allow you to play totally different runs each time.

Some of these relics will be available from the beginning and can be found in altars or in "alternate dimensions". However, you will have to [b]complete multiple achievements[/b] in order to unlock them all!

Some relics have such powerful effects that can completely change the course of your run!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/af144247161c6ae9a0f1210508b612eef67495c7.gif[/img]

[h2]Altars![/h2]
Explore Midgard as fast as you can to find these mystical structures and [b]get their rewards[/b], be it relics or chests. This may decide the future of your survival.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c09a0cc0c159d1eccc86b2e1a38ee96a5cee64d9.png[/img]

[h2]Gold![/h2]
There are multiple ways to obtain gold. You might earn a few coins by defeating enemies, but chances are you'll get a good handful [b]from destroying wooden crates[/b]. You’ll soon learn why gold is so important in times of scarcity…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/dbafd2cf60f3d7711fe4297c6d1e4f69d45d5dd1.png[/img]
[h2]Active and Passive Relics![/h2]
In the [b]Yggdrasil Universe[/b], you will be able to find many Relics. Broadly speaking, they can be divided into Active and Passive Relics. Active Relics can be leveled up to make them more powerful and are focused on defeating enemies. However, Passive Relics will grant you really useful upgrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/89813d36321e1593bacefda7f2830d8608265904.png[/img]

[h2]Glossary![/h2]
The Glossary gathers all the content of the Yggdrasil Universe. Here you’ll be able to see all the Secrets and Relics you have unlocked and those you still have to find.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New content![/h2]
[list]
[*] New artifact! Azure Pendant, grants an Azure container (blue heart).
[*] 5 new Potions!
[*] 6 new Altars!
[*] +20 new Relics!
[*] +20 Secret Relics to discover!
[*] New Boss: Halvard the Destroyer!
[*] New Elites!
[/list]
[h2]Enhanced User Experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potions are no longer picked up if you have full health
[*] Movement of survivors improved, making it easier to change direction.
[*] Active Relics start at level 6 after you pick them up.
[*] You may now open the Constellation panel with the X button of the controller.
[*] You may now upgrade an ability with the space bar of the keyboard.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] All weapons can now inflict critical damage.
[*] Chest rarity is now indicated by a colored outline.
[*] The Wave 4 Boss now appears in Wave 3.
[*] Waves 3 and 4 have been leveled.
[*] Golem animations have been updated.
[*] The Divine Shield Relic is now a Passive Relic, which cannot be upgraded, so its cooldown has been reduced.
[*] Axeldör's Ancient Relic, Berserker, is now Passive, once obtained it cannot be upgraded, but its duration has been increased.
[*] Thyra and Hafgrim have also received some buffs in their Ancient Relics.
[*] Game translated to Spanish
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/34690e30b1cba981807627deaa6d49e40b38d4e3.png[/img]
Last but not least, thanks so much to all our supporters. Our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/RhdgScwtm9]Discord community[/url][/b] is growing every day.
Many improvements have been made thanks to the feedback given by you guys. We want to continue this journey hand in hand with you and create an amazing game to be remembered!💗

notes.title: New Survivor: Hafgrim - Demo Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
[b]New survivor![/b]

The Ragnarök was no match for Hafgrim, all these years of experience made him survive with ease. Every element resides within him. He may seem old, but fire, thunder, and ice have never failed to answer his calling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ffd87407f510aa5432c11341e5f3c6106a243708.gif[/img]
Hafgrim has his own unique Constellation, different from Axeldör’s and Thyra’s.
[list]
[*]Fjölkyngi Staff
[*]Inferno Codex
[*]Thunder Orb
[*]Glacier Quartz
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/0aeae70f9eeef846af982f0f8391e3d90b335a2b.png[/img]

With this new Survivor, a new feature has been added to the game: Status Effects! Check his Constellation to find how to Paralyze, Freeze and Burn your enemies!
Hafgrim has unique stats that make his gameplay completely different yet more challenging than other Survivors. He has 100% Cooldown reduction and 25% increase in Status Effect Probability for all the weapons he wields.

[b]More features![/b]
[list]
[*]Weapons such as Thyra’s Poison Bomb can now Poison, Axeldör’s Brann can Burn and the Electric Rune has a probability of Paralyzing enemies.
[*]Constellation Passive effects have been nerfed. They had too much impact in the game and although we want them to be useful we thought they were too powerful.
[*]Thyra’s Poison Bomb was also too strong as it now applies Poison, so we have reduced the Duration upgrades. Don’t worry it’s still really powerful 😊
[*]Chests have now a small probability of upgrading global stats such as Damage, Area, Duration… instead of a random equipment upgrade.
[*]New Artifact: Heart Locket
[*]Last but not least, 2 new Reliques have been added to the Altars!
[/list]
[b]Some upgrades![/b]
[list]
[*]In the endgame panel you can now see how many Chests you’ve opened and Rerolls you’ve made.
[*]Added a basic tutorial for novice Survivors.
[*]New option added to the Settings panel to remove Status Effects Texts to improve the performance in case you need it.
[*]Twitch feature upgraded: you will now be able to select over which enemies your Chat names will appear (over minions, only bosses…).
[/list]

[i]The Gods are watching us… I forebode dark energy coming North… He may be here sooner than we thought…[/i]

Stay tuned for more updates on our [url=https://discord.gg/2tvnpgyX5x]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Technical Demo Release! v0.1.0
notes.notes:
We are so proud to announce the technical demo of our new game: [b]Nordic Ashes[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/afadb2ba85d8ba136ca3a303aa6835ac3d793ef4.gif[/img]

Norse themed rogue-lite enemy hell, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way. Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your character's stats with constellation ability trees and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…

[previewyoutube=OsJyHm1-CIE;full][/previewyoutube]

This demo is a sneak peak of Nordic Ashes, to show you how gameplay works, some mechanics and art of our game. Most of the content is under development and therefore locked, but we hope you can feel its potential.

[b]In this demo you will find:[/b]
●    Axeldör: a survivor viking that travels from the North Mountains of Raxüss. Fierce warrior who claims his mastery with the sword to slain whatever it comes.
●    Axeldör’s Constellation: You will have access to part of his constellation abilities. That means you’ll be able to upgrade 4 Unique Weapons and Abilities and 4 Passive Abilities. 
●    Midgard: The first world to explore, also known as planet Earth (1st - 3rd Wave).
●    5 Special Weapons: Apart from Axeldör’s main weapons you can obtain other special weapons every time you complete a Wave.
●    1st Boss: The Skavenger King. First of many bosses to come!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/269b50038ae18ea2d1d4a956bdf6f4626a907bcd.png[/img]

[b]What you’ll get in following updates:[/b]
●    Chest upgrades
●    Events
●    2 new Survivors with new abilities, weapons, and their unique constellations
●    Yggdrasil unlocked
●    2nd Boss and more enemies 

Play the demo & Wishlist on Steam to support the development of the game!
